title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
description: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ ) most strategic clients. Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA · End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account · Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization. · International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment · Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management · Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA · Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment · Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site Purpose of the role For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account. About the role, building future proof relationships As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship. The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way. About SITA SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity. Client context The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence. For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business. The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account. Portfolio and services at the key account · Contact centre and voice solutions · Global connectivity solutions · Managed services for communication and office environments · Management of digital workplaces and office environments · Security solutions What will you do? · You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA. · You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels. · You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity. · You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions. · You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus. · You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects. · You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally. · You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team). Terms of employment This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable. Procedure Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client: The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO. Interested? This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you. Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/ Who are we looking for? We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership. · Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments · Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account · Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning · Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level · Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong · Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure · Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Our mission</h2> <p>We're making Africa the first cashless continent.</p> <p>In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.</p> <p>We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.</p> <p>Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...</p></div><h2>How you'll help us achieve it</h2> <p>We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!</p> <p>This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases. </p> <p>As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. bonuses or promotions to strong performers who have been with the company for more than six months</li> <li>Major benefits:</li> <ul> <li>Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country-to-country).</li> <li>6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.</li> <li>Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.</li> <li>$10,000 annual charitable donation matching.</li> <li>Yearly travel to one of our African operating countries.</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Minimum of 7-8 years of professional experience with a minimum of 3-5 years of it spent in a security-related role</li> <li>Strong Experience with Python.</li> <li>Fluent English.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You might be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are excited about finding the right balance between security and velocity. </li> <li>Have opinions on how to secure agentic AI systems and want to put them into practice</li> <li>Enjoy helping other engineers understand and implement secure patterns.</li> <li>Are not afraid to take on complicated systems.</li> <li>Are excited to work on lots of different security-related work, from audits to code refactors. </li> <li>Work to make things easier for the next engineer who will touch your code.</li> <li>Always try to improve as a programmer and colleague.</li> <li>Are interested in building governance frameworks for AI usage in a regulated financial services environment</li> <li>Have experimented with LLM-based security tooling and understand both the promise and the failure modes</li> <li>Push through hard problems without giving up.</li> <li>Have experience remediating non-conformities.</li> <li>Are interested in security-focused source code review and penetration testing.</li> <li>Have an interest in growing and mentoring a team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Engineering at Wave</strong></h2> <p>You'll report to the Security Team Lead and work closely with the CISO, as part of a small 4 person security team, likely rotating with many of our Product and Platform teams, depending on the project you’re working on. Each team is led by a product manager and mentored by a technical lead on the team.</p> <p>You’ll be responsible for your own security projects as well as supporting the engineering organisation on security through advice and design review. title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our our teams across Europe, mostly across our Commercial, Marketing and Operations departments . Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite. Your responsibilities Sourcing, screening & managing candidates - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience. Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies. Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets. AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n). About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role: Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach. Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales. Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them). Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations. Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support. Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with. The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. title: (Senior) Data Engineer - Tracking Infrastructure (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the role Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day. You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams. This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics. What you’ll do Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking) Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization) Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases) Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers) Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use Your profile Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred) Strong skills in Python and SQL Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect), and APIs Familiarity with large-scale data systems and event-based data (tracking, logs, or similar) Experience with Snowflake (or similar DWH) Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions) Understanding of data architecture, testing, and best practices Bonus: experience with DBT, streaming tools, or BI tools What success looks like You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable You improve data reliability, usability, and cost efficiency You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
description: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you. Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland) About Intero Integrity Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data. The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement. We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact. The opportunity This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide. What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week. Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here. What you will do Hands-on software development • You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data • You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams • You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform • You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow • You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure • You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software • You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection) Mentorship & working with partners • You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills • You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing • You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard • You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy • You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently • You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm What you bring Technical expertise • Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform • Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns • Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET) • Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD • The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team • Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices A plus • Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure • Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production • Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context • Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications • Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar) When do we see you as a senior? For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that. You: • Form an independent view on architecture and technology • Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working • Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher • Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow • Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it • Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team What we offer A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters. Salary & terms of employment • Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience • Year-end bonus, dependent on company results • 25 holiday days per year • Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours • Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium • Laptop and phone provided Working environment • Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data • Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines • Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme • An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative Ready to build with us? Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you. title: AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights
description: We Want You to Grow With Us Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. What We Can Offer You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there. What You Will Do Design and implement decoupled data supply chains, spanning landing zones, quality and transformation layers, and consumption layers, to ensure consistently high-quality data reaches analytics and AI systems Implement and document business KPIs as defined by business stakeholders, ensuring full metric traceability; define, implement, and document technical KPIs for AI application performance in collaboration with the data architect, ensuring explainability and observability across all AI-driven outputs Build and maintain a semantic layer that enables AI-based insight generation, bridging structured data assets with natural-language querying and large language model (LLM) integration Lead the expansion of existing BI reporting with AI-supported, RAG-driven analytics, progressively complementing manual report runs with dynamic, contextual insight delivery Develop and maintain data models, transformations, and pipelines using industry-standard tooling, complementing existing data infrastructure and ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability throughout Expose data assets and AI services via well-designed APIs, supporting consumption by both technical and non-technical consumers Act as a frontline coach and enabler for business users and citizen analysts, building AI and data literacy across the organisation and supporting adoption of AI-assisted workflows Embed security-by-design principles into all analytics and AI assets, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse Collaborate across IT, data, security, and business functions to ensure analytics outputs are governed, compliant with EU AI Act and GDPR requirements, and aligned to Intersnack's data sovereignty standards Essential Skills & Experience Proven experience designing and implementing multi-layer data architectures, including landing zones, transformation layers, and consumption layers Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting or transformation language (e.g., Python, dbt) for data modelling and pipeline development Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, vector stores, and RAG patterns, including the ability to build semantic layers and design LLM-integrated workflows using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph Experience with BI and analytics platforms (e.g., Qlik, Power BI, or equivalent) and a clear understanding of how to complement existing reporting with AI-assisted delivery Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or AWS data and AI services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, AWS Glue, SageMaker, or equivalent) Demonstrated ability to engage with and understand non-technical business users, translating AI and data concepts into business language with clarity and confidence Solid understanding of AI security fundamentals, including risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and chain-reaction errors in AI pipelines Awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks, including GDPR, the EU AI Act, and data sovereignty principles applicable in the EU context A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage Valuable Experience Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Purview, or OneLake for unified data governance and discovery, and with Microsoft Foundry for building and deploying LLM-integrated workflows and AI applications Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or procurement environments, with an understanding of the data and reporting challenges specific to these domains Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical application of AI ethics frameworks Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position. About Intersnack IT Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. It’s our target to provide the common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG About Intersnack Group Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. title: Data Engineer - AI Pipelines & DataOps
description: We Want You to Grow With Us High-quality, reliable data is the foundation on which every AI use case is built, and this role is responsible for making that foundation unshakeable. Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben. title: Sales Manager Wholesale Fund Sales (w/m/d)
description: Sales Manager – Wholesale Fund Sales / Asset Management (w/m/d) Bad Homburg (Hybrid) – 75.000 € – 110.000 € Jahresgehalt, 30 Urlaubstage WICHTIG: Wer keine regelmäßige Reisebereitschaft und Präsenz in Bad Homburg (mind. 3 Tage/Woche) mitbringen kann, ist hier falsch. Du willst nicht einfach irgendeinen Vertriebskanal bedienen. Du willst aktiv neue Banken und Private Banker gewinnen und den Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb eigenverantwortlich ausbauen. Hier geht es nicht um reine Produktpräsentation. Hier geht es um den Aufbau eines bundesweiten Partnernetzwerks, um 30 % Jahresziel‑Bonus und um die Gestaltung deiner Vertriebsstrategie mit einem Top‑Verdienst von 75‑110 k €. Unser Kunde Der Kunde ist ein unabhängiger Multi‑Asset‑Manager mit rund 65 Mrd. € verwalteten Vermögen und über 280 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten in Deutschland, Schweiz, Luxemburg und Österreich. Das Unternehmen bietet maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen über alle wesentlichen Assetklassen und zählt zu den führenden Anbietern im deutschsprachigen Raum. Es legt Wert auf Verantwortung, Authentizität, Integrität und Exzellenz. Warum diese Rolle spannend ist Hoher Verdienst: attraktives Fixum plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus Eigenverantwortung: du gestaltest den bundesweiten Ausbau des Vertriebskanals Netzwerkaufbau: nutze und erweitere dein bestehendes Partnernetz zu Sparkassen, Genossenschafts‑ und Privatbanken Investment‑ und Due‑Diligence‑Fokus: du bist maßgeblich an Fondsselektion, Manager‑Bewertung und Portfolio‑Konstruktion beteiligt Hybrid Flexibilität: 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche, flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit Premium Benefits: Firmenwagen, monatliche Shopping‑Card, umfangreiche Weiterbildungsprogramme Aufgaben Proaktive Neukundenakquise: Zielunternehmen identifizieren, erste Kontakte herstellen, Abschlüsse generieren Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen: langfristige Beratung zu Fund‑Solutions und Strategien Erstellung und Optimierung von Präsentationen, Angeboten und Vertriebs‑Materialien Enge Abstimmung mit Produktentwicklung, Portfoliomanagement und Marketing Markt‑ und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Trends erkennen und Vertriebsstrategie anpassen Pflege des CRM‑Systems und Erstellung von Vertriebsreports Mitwirken bei Roadshows, Events und strategischen Team‑Sessions Durchführung von Fonds‑Due‑Diligence, Manager‑Bewertung und Erstellung von Investmentempfehlungen Monitoring von institutionellen Fonds und Mitgestaltung von Portfoliostrategien Qualifikation 3–8 Jahre Erfahrung im Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb mit starkem Fokus auf Private Credit bzw. Private Markets Fund Investing, inkl. Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence und Bewertung. Nachweisliche Erfahrung im institutionellen Fondsmonitoring, in der Portfoliokonstruktion und in der Erstellung von Investmentempfehlungen. Solides Business‑Development‑ und Strategie‑Profil im Finanzumfeld, inkl. erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Investoren, Unternehmen und Senior Stakeholdern. Sehr gute Kommunikations‑, Präsentations‑ und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. Abgeschlossene Bankausbildung (vorzugsweise Sparkasse/Genossenschaft) oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium. Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1) und gutes Englisch (B2). Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen bundesweiten Dienstreisen und Präsenz in Bad Homburg (ca. 3 Tage/Woche). Was hier nicht funktioniert Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker. Fehlende Erfahrung im Private‑Credit‑ oder Private‑Markets‑Umfeld – kein Fit. Keine nachweisbare Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence oder Bewertung von Fondsmanagern – keine Basis für Erfolg. Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse – Kommunikation auf Verhandlungs‑Level unmöglich. „Lone Wolf“ – nicht kompatibel mit teamorientierter Kultur. Benefits Attraktives Vergütungspaket: 75–110 k € Fixum + Bonus, Firmenwagen‑/E‑Auto‑Budget. Monatliche Shopping‑Card im Wert von 50 €. 30 Urlaubstage und flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit. 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche (Hybrid‑Modell). Weiterbildungs‑ und Karriereprogramme (Inhouse, extern, Leadership, High‑Potential). Kita‑Zuschuss, Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad‑Leasing, Gesundheits‑ & Sportangebote. title: Co-Founder*in: Business Development, B2B-Marketing & Hospitality (w/m/d)
description: Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an? Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe! Klassische Verkaufsautomaten sind oft klobig, unflexibel, wartungsintensiv und verbrauchen unnötig viele Ressourcen. Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels. Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen. Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! Was du bei Modumat bewegst Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen: Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen). Fokus Hospitality & Gästeerlebnis: Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern. Partnerschaften & Kundenbeziehungen: Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu B2B-Partnern auf (Hotels, Coworking-Spaces, moderne Gastgeber) und gewinnst gemeinsam mit uns erste Pilotpartner sowie Letters of Intent (LOIs) für den EXIST-Antrag. Geschäftsmodell & EXIST-Antrag: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Teil unserer Gründungsreise – von der Markt- und Zielgruppenanalyse über faire Pricing-Modelle bis hin zur Finanzplanung im Rahmen des EXIST-Stipendiums. Webpräsenz & Außenwirkung: Du gestaltest unseren Auftritt (Website, Pitch Decks, Kommunikationsmaterial) so, dass aus innovativer Technik verständliche, einladende Mehrwerte für unsere Kund*innen werden. Was du mitbringst (Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben – viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!) Studienhintergrund: Du studierst BWL, Marketing, Hospitality-/Tourismus-Management, International Business, Kommunikationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach (kurz vor dem Masterabschluss oder bereits abgeschlossen). Gespür für Hospitality & Service (großes Plus): Du kennst die Dynamik der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie (z. B. Personalmangel, Gästebedürfnisse, 24/7-Service) aus Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder deinem Netzwerk – oder du hast große Lust, diese spannende Branche mit sinnstiftender Technologie zu unterstützen. Kommunikationsstärke & Kundenfokus: Du hörst Kund*innen genau zu, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und kannst komplexe Produkte empathisch, klar und überzeugend vermitteln. Offenheit für Tech & moderne KI-Tools: Du musst keine Zeile Code schreiben. Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig auf digitale Innovationen bist und moderne KI-Tools (wie ChatGPT, Canva/Design-Tools oder Recherche-Tools) gerne nutzt, um dir den Arbeitsalltag kreativ und effizient zu erleichtern. Gestaltungswille & Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, schätzt aber genauso den engen Austausch im Team, um gemeinsam Ideen weiterzuentwickeln. Was dich bei uns erwartet Gründen auf echter Augenhöhe: Du kommst nicht als Angestellte*r dazu, sondern als vollwertige Co-Founderin bzw. vollwertiger Co-Founder. Wir treffen Entscheidungen gemeinsam und legen großen Wert auf eine offene, wertschätzende und transparente Teamkultur. Finanzielle Sicherheit & faire Anteile: Über das EXIST-Gründerstipendium erhältst du nach Bewilligung bis zu 2.500 €/Monat , um dich ohne finanziellen Druck auf das Startup zu konzentrieren. Zudem erhältst du eine faire, transparente Beteiligung (Equity) an der gemeinsamen GmbH. Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: Ob in unserem schönen, ausgestatteten Projektraum an der h_da (Gebäude D22) oder flexibel im Homeoffice – wir richten unsere Arbeitsweise so ein, dass sie zu unserem Leben passt. Ein verlässliches Fundament: Du startest nicht bei null. Technik, Prototyp und erste Förderungen sind bereits da – und wir (Raphael & Frederik) stehen dir als verlässliche, hilfsbereite Partner bei allen technischen Fragen jederzeit den Rücken frei. Starkes Netzwerk & Mentoring: Rundum-Support durch YUBIZZ!, das Startup-Zentrum der Hochschule Darmstadt (Workshops, Gründungsförderung & Ökosystem), sowie individuelles Mentoring und Sparring durch unseren Gründercoach Prof. Dr. Michael von Rüden. Hast du Lust, Modumat gemeinsam mit uns groß zu machen? Wenn du dich in vielen Punkten wiederfindest – auch wenn vielleicht nicht jeder einzelne Haken zu 100 % sitzt –, freuen wir uns riesig, von dir zu hören! Schreib uns einfach eine kurze, unkomplizierte Nachricht mit deinem LinkedIn-Profil oder Lebenslauf. Lass uns gerne ganz entspannt bei einem Kaffee oder Tee an der Hochschule Darmstadt oder via Video-Call kennenlernen und schauen, ob die Chemie stimmt! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend </strong></h2> <h4><strong>The Opportunity: </strong></h4> <p>Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.<br><br>You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.</p> <p>AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be accountable for the performance of <strong>two</strong> distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.</li> <li>Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.</li> <li>Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.</li> <li>Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.</li> <li>Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.</li> <li>Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.</li> <li>Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.</li> <li>Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.</li> <li>Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.</li> <li>Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">124,571</span><span data-sheets-root="1"> </span>- EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">149,485</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. </p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-

Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.</li> <li>Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.</li> <li>Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.</li> <li>Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.</li> <li>Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">117,949</span><span data-sheets-root="1"> </span>- GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">141,539</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.  </p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. title: Director, European Government Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT ROCKET LAB</strong></p> <p>Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.</p></div><p><strong>DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS</strong></p> <p>As the Director – European Government Operations, based in <strong>Munich/ Berlin, </strong>Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market</li> <li>Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives</li> <li>Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies</li> <li>Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs</li> <li>Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs</li> <li>Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab’s interests are represented and understood</li> <li>Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business</li> <li>Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company’s visibility and credibility</li> <li>Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways</li> </ul> <p><strong>YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field</li> <li>12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe</li> <li>Professional fluency in German and English</li> <li>Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions</li> <li>Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring</li> <li>Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes</li> <li>Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors</li> <li>Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies</li> <li>Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting</li> <li>Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks</li> </ul> <p><em><u>This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas</u></em>.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">WHAT TO EXPECT</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p>Important information:</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:</strong></span></p> <p><em>To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR <a href="https://urldefense.us/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.pmddtc.state.gov_-3Fid-3Dddtc-5Fkb-5Farticle-5Fpage-26sys-5Fid-3D24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987&d=DwMFog&c=N_fLK0KxmM34zjMadXHMx_SQYmXWO3FX0MRVr1hBcn4&r=prjnch9sxomG2ahCicblmM3m-FuPObepspoR1qvWq2I&m=ExC44mBPk2emo4Fr0xPSGZN0UraQ1ZtkDTxwR7iWw5rixcFQb-Wjlv7lJcecLldz&s=0lfm4LyRtFwK220WHBK11DGHWSVvVhQEcfa5G_2Nf18&e=">here</a>.</em></p> <p><em>Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</em></p> <p><em>Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at <a ---------- dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.</em></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:</strong></span></p> <p><em>For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. </em></p> <p><em>Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here <a class="fui-Link ___m14voj0 f3rmtva f1ern45e f1deefiw f1n71otn f1q5o8ev f1h8hb77 f1vxd6vx f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f9n3di6 f1ids18y fygtlnl f1deo86v f12x56k7 f1iescvh ftqa4ok f50u1b5 fs3pq8b f1hghxdh f1tymzes f1x7u7e9 f1cmlufx f10aw75t fsle3fq" href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2020/01/23/2020-00574/international-traffic-in-arms-regulations-us-munitions-list-categories-i-ii-and-iii" target="_blank">ITAR Regulations.</a></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Group Digital Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.</p> <p>We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.</p> <p>Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.</li> <li><strong>Make it Happen:</strong> We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Always Innovate:</strong> We push boundaries with creativity and technology.</li> <li><strong>Foster Belonging:</strong> We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.</li> </ul> <p>To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit <a href="http://www.gumgum.com/careers">www.gumgum.com/careers</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Based in Düsseldorf, the Group Digital Director, Germany is an experienced player/coach who leads a local sales team of two while remaining personally active in the market to drive revenue targets across the Düsseldorf agency ecosystem. Serving as the key regional leader, this role leverages senior holding-company relationships across major media agencies to open doors, negotiate trading deals, and secure agency development opportunities. Operating in close alignment with the Hamburg team and broader EU stakeholders, the Director establishes strategic patch goals, accurate financial forecasting, and seller development while representing GumGum at industry events.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Achieve</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and exceed the Düsseldorf revenue target while leading and coaching a team of two sellers.</li> <li>Serve as a player/coach in-market, maintaining senior holding-company relationships, joining key pitches, and unblocking deals.</li> <li>Negotiate, renew, and grow Düsseldorf agency trading deals and commercial agreements to ensure profitability and scale.</li> <li>Execute annual/quarterly planning, set sales strategies, manage pipeline coverage, and deliver accurate financial forecasts.</li> <li>Lead, motivate, and develop the Düsseldorf sales team through regular operating cadences and performance reviews.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Hamburg sales leadership and wider EU teams to drive national agency development and product adoption.</li> <li>Represent GumGum at German industry events and collaborate cross-functionally with AdOps, Client Success, and Marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in digital media, ad tech, or advertising sales, with significant time in the German market.</li> <li>Native or near-native German fluency and professional fluency in English.</li> <li>Established, trusted relationships across the Düsseldorf agency ecosystem (especially holding companies and key independents).</li> <li>Proven sales management experience, with a track record of developing sellers and leading distributed or split-location teams.</li> <li>Deep understanding of programmatic buying, ad serving, and the German digital ad landscape (knowledge of attention/contextual solutions is a plus).</li> <li>Demonstrated experience negotiating agency trading deals and holding firm on commercial terms.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, and CRM tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Learn about our benefits & perks package at <a If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process!</li> <li>Note: GumGum fosters a flexible work environment, offering GumGummers the ability to work either in-office or remotely/from home. However, for occasional in-person collaboration, we kindly ask that this position be located within a 'commutable' distance to our office.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Awards</strong></p> <ul> <li>2025 & 2026 Digiday Media Awards Europe Best Contextual Targeting Offering</li> <li>2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology & Service Provider, Finalist</li> <li>2025 MARKETECH APAC Marketing Technology Awards Silver Winner for Best Contextual Advertising Tech Platform</li> </ul> <p>We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.</p> <p><strong>Follow Us on Social</strong></p> <ul> <li>Instagram: @gumgum</li> <li>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/">https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/</a></li> <li>YouTube: @GumGumInc</li> <li>TikTok: @itsgumgum<br><br><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> GumGum recruits only for active roles on our careers page, accepts applications through Greenhouse, and communicates only via LinkedIn or ----- / ----- email addresses.
