title: Sales Director, ITS, Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who is Seyond?</strong></span></p> <p>Seyond™ is a global leader in high fidelity LiDAR solutions, powering the future of mobility across ADAS, ITS, Robotics, Stationary and Off-Road industries. Seyond delivers a dynamic portfolio of robust, high resolution LiDAR sensors, perception software, and the Seyond ITS Management Platform (SIMPL). Founded in Silicon Valley with a global footprint, Seyond is dedicated to the highest quality engineering and manufacturing, and unwavering commitment to our customers.</p></div><p><strong>About Seyond ITS</strong></p> <p>Drawing on deep expertise in precision sensing and edge intelligence, Seyond offers a robust portfolio of LiDAR sensors, perception software, and transportation analytics solutions designed to improve roadway safety, traffic operations, and multimodal mobility.</p> <p>This portfolio includes the SIMPL™ ITS Management Platform, Seyond’s LiDAR-based detection solution for smart intersections and highways. SIMPL operates as a distinct business unit with dedicated pricing and go-to-market authority across two verticals: urban intersection management and interurban highway, tunnel, and tolling detection.</p> <p><strong>Sales Director, ITS, Europe</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Remote, Europe</p> <p><strong>Team: </strong>Seyond ITS — SIMPL, our LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection platform</p> <p><strong>Employment type: </strong>Full-time</p> <h2><strong>About Seyond SIMPL</strong></h2> <p>SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.</p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Sales Director, ITS, Europe to build and lead SIMPL’s sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will sit above SIMPL’s country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and lead SIMPL’s European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.</li> <li>Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.</li> <li>Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.</li> <li>Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.</li> <li>Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.</li> <li>Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.</li> <li>Partner with SIMPL’s European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.</li> <li>Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.</li> <li>A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine “hunter,” not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.</li> <li>Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.</li> <li>Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.</li> <li>Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.</li> <li>Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.</li> <li>Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.</li> <li>Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2> <p><em>Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.     </em></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sr. Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
description: <p><strong>About SiTime</strong></p> <p>SiTime is the Precision Timing company.</p> <p>Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.</p> <p>Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. title: AI Builder — Working Student
description: <p><strong>EggAI Labs</strong> · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="4"><em>Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.</em></p> <h2 id="eggai-labs" class="code-line" data-line="6">EggAI Labs</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="8">We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="10">As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.</p> <h2 id="the-problem-evalops" class="code-line" data-line="12">The problem: EvalOps</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="13"><strong>How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?</strong></p> <p class="code-line" data-line="15">We will explore <strong>EvalOps</strong>: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="17">These questions will guide the initial work:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="18"> <li class="code-line" data-line="18"><strong>Regression suites</strong>: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="19"><strong>Coverage estimation</strong>: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="20"><strong>Live monitoring</strong>: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="21"><strong>Eval analysis</strong>: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.</li> </ul> <h2 id="the-role" class="code-line" data-line="24">The role</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="26">As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="27"> <li class="code-line" data-line="27">Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="28">Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="29">Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="30">Communicate decisions and learning clearly.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="31">Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="32">Code and build end to end.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="34">This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.</p> <h2 id="three-pillars-different-passions" class="code-line" data-line="36">Three pillars, different passions</h2> <table class="code-line" data-line="38"> <thead class="code-line" data-line="38"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="38"> <th style="text-align: left;">Pillar</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Driving question</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Possible EvalOps focus</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody class="code-line" data-line="40"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="40"> <td><strong>Product</strong></td> <td>What should we build?</td> <td>Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="41"> <td><strong>Engineering</strong></td> <td>How should we build it?</td> <td>Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="42"> <td><strong>Data Science</strong></td> <td>How do we know it works?</td> <td>Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p class="code-line" data-line="45">We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.</p> <h2 id="what-we-value" class="code-line" data-line="45">What we value</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="46"> <li class="code-line" data-line="46"><strong>Problem obsession</strong>. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="47"><strong>Initiative and follow-through</strong>. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="48"><strong>Evidence of making things work</strong>. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="49"><strong>Independent judgment</strong>. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="50"><strong>Generosity in collaboration</strong>. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. </li> </ul> <h2 id="what-is-required" class="code-line" data-line="53">What is required</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="54"> <li class="code-line" data-line="54">You are pursuing a Master’s degree.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="55">You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="56">You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="58">Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.</p> <h2 id="what-you-will-gain" class="code-line" data-line="60">What you will gain</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="61"> <li class="code-line" data-line="61"><strong>Industry insight</strong>. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="62"><strong>Meaningful ownership</strong>. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="63"><strong>Close mentorship</strong>. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="64"><strong>Room to develop</strong>. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="65"><strong>A say in the Lab’s direction</strong>. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="66"><strong>Competitive compensation</strong>, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.</li> </ul> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>A short cover letter is required.</p> <p>Your CV tells us <strong>what</strong> you have done so far, but we're also interested in the <strong>why</strong>. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.</p> <p>This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About EggAI</h1> <p class="code-line" data-line="8"><strong>Agentic workforces are inevitable. title: Senior Finance Manager, Germany (m/w/d)
description: <p></p> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Location:</strong> Hamburg, Germany<br><strong>Working pattern:</strong> Full-time, on-site<br><strong>Focus:</strong> German BESS portfolio, across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About BW ESS</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain and Sweden, with more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems, approximately 12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.</div> <div> </div> <div>Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.</div> <div> </div> <div>To find out more, visit: <a href="https://bw-ess.com/">https://bw-ess.com/</a></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>How We Work</strong></div> <div>Our culture rests on a few clear foundations: talent density over team size, flexible people over fixed structures, context over control, results over processes, and transparent, clear feedback. We move fast, give people real ownership early, and expect strong judgement and accountability in return.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>The Role</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is seeking a Senior Finance Manager, Germany to take finance ownership of its German BESS portfolio across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting.</div> <div> </div> <div>This is a broad, hands-on role combining strong financial control with commercial finance, portfolio management and transaction support. You will act as the principal finance partner to the German business, working closely with Development, Construction, Asset Management, Strategic Finance, Treasury and Tax, as well as JV partners, lenders and external advisers.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></div> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Construction finance.</strong> Take finance ownership of projects through the construction phase, including oversight of project budgets, expenditure, cash requirements and capital drawdowns. You will ensure project costs are properly tracked, allocated and reported, with clear visibility of performance against budget and investment case.</li> <li><strong>Investment and project support.</strong> Support project teams and Strategic Finance with FID materials, financial analysis and other investment decision-making. You will also help track construction-stage VAT, supplier payment terms, capex classification and cash-flow timing for German SPVs.</li> <li><strong>German portfolio operations.</strong> Take finance ownership of the operating German portfolio, including portfolio management, FP&A and management reporting. You will monitor financial and operational performance against budgets, forecasts and investment cases, providing clear analysis to management and JV partners.</li> <li><strong>Lender and stakeholder reporting.</strong> Manage lender and stakeholder reporting, including covenant monitoring, debt-service metrics, distributions and other project-finance requirements.</li> <li><strong>Transactions.</strong> Support project financings, refinancings, equity transactions and other strategic transactions across the German portfolio. This includes financial analysis, modelling, due diligence and transaction support, working with Strategic Finance, Treasury and external advisers.</li> <li><strong>Financial reporting and control.</strong> Take responsibility for the integrity and accuracy of financial reporting across the German portfolio, including German GAAP/HGB, German tax compliance, local statutory accounts, audits and VAT. You will oversee outsourced accounting providers and ensure high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, statutory accounts, audit and tax compliance.</li> <li><strong>Governance and systems.</strong> Maintain appropriate financial controls, governance and reporting processes across German SPVs and joint ventures, while supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of finance systems, processes and reporting infrastructure.</li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <div><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>10 years’ relevant finance experience, ideally in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities, oil and gas or another asset-intensive environment</div> </li> <li> <div>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related discipline</div> </li> <li> <div>Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or a German equivalent is preferred; substantial relevant experience may be considered in place of a formal qualification</div> </li> <li> <div>Demonstrable experience across both statutory accounting and FP&A, including close, audit, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience supporting project or portfolio economics, investment appraisal, valuations, cash-flow forecasting or financial modelling</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong knowledge of German statutory reporting, tax and regulatory requirements</div> </li> <li> <div>Confidence operating across SPVs, GmbH structures, complex corporate and JV structures, and project-finance entities</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing outsourced service providers</div> </li> <li> <div>Advanced Excel and financial-modelling skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Familiarity with ERP systems, preferably including system migration or integration experience</div> </li> <li> <div>Professional fluency in German and English</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice to have:</strong> Exposure to project finance, debt covenants, lender reporting, M&A due diligence or transaction support. Experience with data automation, BI tools, scripting or AI-enabled analytical tools is also advantageous.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Why Join</strong></div> <div>This is a high-impact finance leadership role at the centre of BW ESS’s German growth. You will work across construction, operations, transactions and reporting, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders, JV partners, lenders and external advisers.</div> <div> </div> <div>You’ll help build the finance platform behind major energy storage assets and play a key role in supporting BW ESS’s long-term growth in Germany.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is committed to building a high-performing, inclusive team and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.</div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Your personal information will be processed in accordance with our <a href="https://bw-ess.com/bw-ess-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Director (digital advertising Sales)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.</p> <p>We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.</p> <p>Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.</li> <li><strong>Make it Happen:</strong> We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Always Innovate:</strong> We push boundaries with creativity and technology.</li> <li><strong>Foster Belonging:</strong> We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.</li> </ul> <p>To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit <a href="http://www.gumgum.com/careers">www.gumgum.com/careers</a>.</p></div><p>The Account Director role is an individual contributor responsible for prospecting and closing sales in GumGum’s market-leading contextual advertising platform. Reporting to the NSW Sales Director, this role is responsible for developing key relationships within large and mid-size agencies, with occasional managerial guidance on client calls. We require this role to work relatively autonomously while being supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team.<br><br>Account Directors have experience and deep knowledge of the online media landscape and the advertising community and have at least 6+ years of digital media experience.  The Account Director uses existing processes to solve a variety of challenging problems to deliver for clients. The role requires applying independent judgment and discretion to select appropriate options from GumGum’s defined and proven products.</p> <p>Note: GumGum fosters a hybrid flexible work environment. The Sales team collaborates in office 3 days per week: Tuesday-Thursday. </p> <p><strong>What You'll Achieve</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a $3M–$4M+ annual book of business across NSW, driving both renewal revenue and fresh new business</li> <li>Hunt for new opportunities through cold outreach, compelling presentations, RFP responses, and creative client entertainment</li> <li>Grow relationships with large and mid-sized agencies into long-term, strategic partnerships</li> <li>Turn marketing-generated leads into qualified pipeline and closed deals</li> <li>Expand current clients' investment by introducing them to GumGum's display and video offerings</li> <li>Become a trusted advisor to brands and agencies, understanding their goals and matching them with the right GumGum solutions</li> <li>Shape our product roadmap by bringing real client insight back to the Product team</li> <li>Partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to make sure every proposal lands and delivers on client expectations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in Media, Marketing, or Advertising is preferred</li> <li>6+ years of digital advertising sales experience, with a proven track record of hitting or exceeding targets</li> <li>Experience managing a large book of business, plus hands-on programmatic expertise</li> <li>Strong, strategic relationships across Australian agencies</li> <li>Confidence in Salesforce — logging meetings and calls, pulling reports, and keeping your pipeline sharp</li> <li>Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for building strategic client relationships</li> <li>A sharp eye for detail and organisation, plus quick problem-solving while guiding stakeholders through the process</li> <li>Solid business acumen (P&L, COGS, revenue drivers) and the analytical judgment to craft smart solutions from data</li> </ul> <p>Learn about our benefits & perks package at <a href="http://gumgum.com/benefits">gumgum.com/benefits</a>. If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Awards</strong></p> <ul> <li>2025 & 2026 Digiday Media Awards Europe Best Contextual Targeting Offering</li> <li>2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology & Service Provider, Finalist</li> <li>2025 MARKETECH APAC Marketing Technology Awards Silver Winner for Best Contextual Advertising Tech Platform</li> </ul> <p>We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.</p> <p><strong>Follow Us on Social</strong></p> <ul> <li>Instagram: @gumgum</li> <li>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/">https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/</a></li> <li>YouTube: @GumGumInc</li> <li>TikTok: @itsgumgum<br><br><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> GumGum recruits only for active roles on our careers page, accepts applications through Greenhouse, and communicates only via LinkedIn or ----- / ----- email addresses. We never use chat apps, ask you to register on other recruiting sites, or request financial information, payments or purchases. <a href="https://gumgum.com/contact">Verify suspicious outreach</a> before sharing personal information.</li> </ul></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p></p> <h1 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Forward Deployed Engineer</h1> <h2>About HSO</h2> <p>HSO is a global Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and a long standing strategic relationship with Microsoft. We help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to modernise operations, accelerate innovation and deliver meaningful business outcomes.</p> <p>In 2026, HSO achieved Microsoft Frontier Partner status, recognising our advanced capabilities across Microsoft Cloud and AI and our ability to help customers move beyond AI experimentation into secure, governed, enterprise scale production.</p> <p>With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, we combine industry knowledge, technical excellence and a practical, people first approach to transformation.</p> <p>As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we’re building a new generation of customer facing engineering talent to help organisations turn the potential of AI and agentic technologies into real, measurable value.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.</p> <p>You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.</p> <p>This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You’ll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer’s wider technology estate.</p> <p>A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.</p> <p>From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.</p> <p>The role does not end at first deployment. You’ll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You’ll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <h3>Own Customer Outcomes</h3> <p>• Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.</p> <p>• Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.</p> <p>• Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.</p> <p>• Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.</p> <p>• Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.</p> <h3>Lead Discovery and Solution Design</h3> <p>• Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.</p> <p>• Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.</p> <p>• Understand the customer’s existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.</p> <p>• Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.</p> <p>• Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.</p> <p>• Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.</p> <h3>Build and Ship Production Solutions</h3> <p>• Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.</p> <p>• Develop AI powered applications, copilots, agents, automations, integrations and workflow solutions.</p> <p>• Build solutions that make effective use of modern enterprise data platforms and ensure AI applications are supported by reliable, governed and accessible data.</p> <p>• Integrate solutions with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow and customer owned systems, APIs and data platforms.</p> <p>• Apply modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability and secure development.</p> <p>• Work iteratively. Deliver value quickly, learn from real world usage and progressively harden solutions for enterprise production.</p> <h3>Engineer AI and Agentic Solutions</h3> <p>• Design and implement robust agentic workflows, human in the loop processes and, where appropriate, multi agent architectures.</p> <p>• Apply modern techniques across retrieval, grounding, orchestration, tool integration, context engineering and evaluation.</p> <p>• Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails to test AI behaviour, reliability and quality before and after deployment.</p> <p>• Implement appropriate responsible AI, security, monitoring and governance controls.</p> <p>• Ensure data quality, lineage, governance and availability are considered as fundamental components of AI solution design.</p> <p>• Use operational data and user feedback to continuously improve solution quality and performance.</p> <h3>Create Reusable HSO Capability</h3> <p>• Reuse existing HSO assets, accelerators and delivery patterns wherever they improve speed and quality.</p> <p>• Turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, engineering patterns and playbooks.</p> <p>• Contribute actively to HSO’s AI, Data, Frontier and Horizon engineering communities.</p> <p>• Share practical knowledge across regions, practices and delivery teams.</p> <p>• Support and mentor other engineers as the Forward Deployed Engineering capability grows.</p> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>We’re looking for experienced engineers who combine strong technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate confidently with customers.</p> <p>You’ll ideally bring:</p> <p>• Significant experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, data engineering, solution development, technical consulting or enterprise technology delivery, with senior level ownership of complex solutions.</p> <p>• Strong hands on experience building and operating production grade solutions on at title: Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek
description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten. Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen. Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software. Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines. Hier is waar We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent. We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. Tijdens de ontwerpfase werden ook de technische en financiële haalbaarheid grondig gecontroleerd. Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière. Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler. Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken). MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou. Dit bieden wij Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Binnen onze unit Airports werk je aan hoogwaardige projecten die direct bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en duurzame luchthaveninfrastructuur. Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en neemt een sleutelrol in complexe projecten. De uitdaging In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Je opereert midden in de luchthavenoperatie, waar veiligheid, continuïteit en kwaliteit leidend zijn. Je neemt het voortouw in het ontwikkelen van slimme, integrale installatietechnische oplossingen en adviseert opdrachtgevers op strategisch en conceptueel niveau. Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is. Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s. Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen. Het uitvoeren en controleren van berekeningen en het beoordelen van het werk van engineers en technici. Het afstemmen met projectleiders, ontwerpers, andere disciplines en externe partijen over technische keuzes en randvoorwaarden. Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen in kwaliteit, planning en budget en hierover proactief schakelen binnen het projectteam. Het begeleiden, coachen en inhoudelijk ondersteunen van junior engineers binnen projecten. Het leveren van input voor rapportages, adviezen en offertes. Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports. De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten. We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen. We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. title: Product Engineer
description: Bij Salland Engineering zoeken we een Product Engineer die een belangrijke rol speelt in het goed functioneren van onze pilot line en in de ondersteuning van het productieteam. In deze functie ben je de verbindende schakel tussen productie, engineering en klant. Het team Product Engineering, onderdeel van de Semitest Group, wordt steeds belangrijker binnen Salland Engineering. Binnen deze omgeving ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vrijgeven van testoplossingen voor kwalificatie, karakterisatie en productie test. Daarnaast begeleid je kwalificatieruns in samenwerking met de klant, de planner en onze reliability partner. Je werkt continu aan verbeteringen en streeft samen met je team naar efficiëntere processen en tooling. Storingen zie je niet als obstakel, maar als uitdaging. Je schakelt snel, denkt analytisch én praktisch en zorgt ervoor dat we optimaal blijven presteren. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en hebt veel contact met operators, teamleiders, engineeringcollega’s en de planner. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden Je begeleidt nieuwe productintroducties (NPI) in productieomgevingen; Je beheert en evalueert kwalificatie- en betrouwbaarheidstesten, zoals HTOL, HAST en Temp Cycle; Je analyseert testdata om prestaties, yield en betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen; Je troubleshoot op device-, hardware- en softwareniveau en voert root cause analyses uit bij testafwijkingen, yield drops en product failures; Je verleent technische ondersteuning aan productie- en testteams bij productissues en analyseert en lost device-, test- en procesafwijkingen op; Je borgt soepele overgangen naar high volume manufacturing (HVM); Je treedt op als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stemt technische verbeteringen af met leveranciers en externe testpartners; Je coördineert technische projecten gericht op testoptimalisatie, yieldverbetering en productinnovatie en stelt product release reports, karakterisatieverslagen en yieldanalyses op. Waar ga je werken Aangenaam, wij zijn Salland Engineering uit Zwolle! Al meer dan 30 jaar ontwikkelen wij oplossingen en leveren wij diensten voor het testen van chips. Onze technologie vind je terug in alledaagse producten zoals smartphones, tablets en auto's. Samen met zo’n 95 collega’s werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve projecten en bedienen we 's werelds grootste fabrikanten van chips en meetinstrumenten. Wat krijg je van ons Een uitdagende baan in een hightech-omgeving. We waarderen het nemen van initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid dragen, maar er is meer! title: Flight Software Architect
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: What we would love to see from you Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders. In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems. Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications. Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems. Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies. A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment. Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints. The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions. Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures. Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams. A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space. Why you should join us! What you will need 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure. Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day. As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands. You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together. You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected. You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law. You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence. You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early. You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster. You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years. In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production. Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough. You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases. Experience with Kubernetes. Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. Want to know more? We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265. title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description: Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making as our Data Scientist (m/f/d) At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond. Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making. How you’ll be hosting with heart: Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability. Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making. Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making. Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives. Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience. Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models. Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. What you need to shoot for the stars: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems. Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling. Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments. Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets. Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity. Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations. Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds. We're designed to stay because: Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office. Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period. Relocation Support : We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office. Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas). Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development. Limitless learning : We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget. Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly. Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering. Everything for our Limehomies : We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉 Who we are: Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
description: 10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description: Your Role As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't. What you'll do End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage. Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion. Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories. Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance. Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID. What you bring Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus. Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one. Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster. Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase. Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization. What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look. Initial Call with our Talent Partner : A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role. Video Call with Head of Product : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round : A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members. In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws. title: Director Research & Development
description: Purpose of the job The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies. The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution. KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ideation and concept generation Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding. Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines. Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions. Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems. Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities. Exploration, feasibility and concept development Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate. Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach. Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative. Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies. Stakeholder engagement and governance Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors. Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts. Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies. Transition to implementation Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation. Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery. Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role. Your profile REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales. Broad understanding of airline business and technical domains, sufficient to assess a variety of potential initiatives. Good understanding of relevant technical aspects; experience in a Business Analyst role is an advantage. Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and guide diverse groups towards innovative solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain and present complex concepts and inspire teams. Analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate complex options and communicate evidence-based recommendations. Ability to work independently on multiple subjects and collaborate effectively in a multicultural matrix organization. Responsibilities and tasks of the position are not limited to the above mentioned, and deviations can occur at any point in time as the position evolves and in concert with the manager. Why us?
