title: UX Designer
description: Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt. Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday? Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken. Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers. Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie. Wat je gaat doen: Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart; Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes; Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken; Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s; Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen; Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken; Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents; Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt; Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie. Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe mensen dingen gebruiken en waarom ze bepaalde keuzes maken. Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en verbanden leggen. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die eindeloos blijft onderzoeken: je krijgt energie van het concreet maken van inzichten en het samenbrengen van verschillende perspectieven in een heldere oplossing. Je kunt schakelen tussen het grotere verhaal en het detail. Je begrijpt wat een strategische keuze betekent voor een gebruikerservaring en weet wat er nodig is om een idee technisch en organisatorisch haalbaar te maken. Je bent zelfstandig in je werk, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en kunt je ontwerpkeuzes goed uitleggen aan zowel klanten als collega’s. Je hoeft niet overal het antwoord op te hebben. Wel wil je begrijpen wat er speelt en samen tot een oplossing komen die klopt. Onze ideale UX Designer … heeft een aantal jaar ervaring als UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer; heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services; kan zelfstandig onderzoek, conceptontwikkeling, interaction design en prototyping oppakken; heeft ruime ervaring met Figma en bijvoorbeeld Miro of vergelijkbare tools; vindt het leuk om workshops en co-creatiesessies te begeleiden; kan goed samenwerken met strategen, service designers, visual designers en developers; beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, vanwege de grote mate van klantcontact, interviews, workshops en samenwerking; heeft een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld vanuit CMD, Design for Interaction of een vergelijkbare opleiding; is nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en experimenteert ermee in eigen processen. Je ziet AI als een nieuwe manier om onderzoek te doen, samen te werken, te ontwerpen en ideeën sneller te verkennen en toetsen. Wat bieden we jou? Een salaris van €3.600 tot €4.700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring; Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam en thuis; Een persoonlijk budget van €750 voor je thuiswerkplek; 25 vakantiedagen; Een goede pensioenregeling en leasefietsregeling; Een NS Business Card; Een persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelplan en veel ruimte om te leren van collega’s en vakexperts; Afwisselende projecten waarin strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis samenkomen; Een team van nieuwsgierige en betrokken collega’s die kwaliteit belangrijk vinden; De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Norday. Norday stimuleert een diverse werkomgeving en is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden en identiteiten aan om te solliciteren. Daarnaast nemen we sociale en ecologische impact mee in onze besluitvorming en in jouw performance reviews. Vragen? Neem dan contact met ons op via 010 221 46 00 of Norday: Ready to Lead Norday helpt organisaties richting te geven aan verandering en hun veranderkracht te vergroten. We combineren strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis om complexe vraagstukken concreet te maken en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die in de praktijk werken. Van transformatiestrategie, digitale en datastrategie tot nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen: we gidsen organisaties bij waar ze naartoe willen en helpen ze om daar te komen. We werken in multidisciplinaire teams samen met opdrachtgevers in cultuur, zorg en welzijn, educatie, overheden, NGO’s en climate tech aan de grote vraagstukken van deze tijd. Daarbij verbinden we de mogelijkheden van technologie met de context van organisaties en de mensen die ermee werken. Norday is onderdeel van Handpicked en een B Corp. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji: (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. title: Afstudeerstage IT
description: Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou! BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière. Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten 1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering) BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit. Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure. 2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk. Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt. 3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken. Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability. 4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen. Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World. Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact. Wij bieden jou Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding ; Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact; Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host; De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team; Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS . Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”; Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes. Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding; Je bent woonachtig in de omgeving van Veghel. Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden; Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wij zijn BAS! We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines. Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen? Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Support & Infrastruktur bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team für einen zuverlässigen IT-Betrieb. Ob Anwendersupport, Hardware, Server oder Telefonie: Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unsere IT im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert, löst technische Probleme und entwickelst dein Know-how dabei kontinuierlich weiter. Dein Aufgabenbereich Du bist da, wenn die Technik mal nicht mitspielt: Als erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterstützt du bei Fragen und Störungen rund um Hard- und Software und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme schnell und unkompliziert gelöst werden. Ein funktionierender Arbeitsplatz beginnt bei einer zuverlässigen IT: Du richtest Arbeitsplätze, Notebooks und weitere Hardware ein, betreust unsere Endgeräte und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen technisch gut ausgestattet arbeiten können. Auch hinter den Kulissen muss alles laufen: Gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team betreust du unsere bestehende IT-Infrastruktur – von Servern und Netzwerken bis hin zu unserer Voice-over-IP-Telefonie – und unterstützt dabei, einen stabilen Betrieb sicherzustellen. title: Customer Integration Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Application Engineering Team(s) We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Integration Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up. 🧠 Your day-to-day In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting our customers throughout the entire development lifecycle, from the initial integration phase to the final validation of our technology. You will ensure that customers receive responsive, high-quality technical support and work closely with both our clients and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of our technology into their vehicles. Located near our customers, you will be in a prime position to perform rapid diagnostics, identify issues in real time, and collaborate directly with customer engineering teams. This proximity allows you to maintain a holistic understanding of the system and effectively distinguish between vehicle-related issues and those specific to the Wayve AI Driver. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Provide hands-on technical support to customers throughout the development and validation process Serve as the bridge between customer vehicle integration teams and Wayve’s internal engineering teams Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to our technology independently Escalate complex or critical issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders Develop deep understanding of customer systems and APIs (e.g. drive-by-wire) to effectively guide internal teams Maintain a system-level perspective to identify root causes, whether vehicle-based or software-related 🙌 You should apply if Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking Proven ability to lead investigations into platform or vehicle issues in collaboration with internal and customer teams Extensive hands-on experience with development vehicles Proficiency with diagnostic and calibration tools (e.g. CANape or similar) Familiarity with terminal usage and a willingness to develop basic programming skills Solid understanding of vehicle communication protocols (e.g. CAN, Ethernet) and automotive system architectures Practical experience working in an automotive environment, ideally with a track record of bringing products to production Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with both customers and internal teams Willingness to travel as required 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews [Integration Competency, 60mins] Deep-dive technical interviews [Vehicle Integration, 60mins, Automotive, 60mins] Final interview : [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins]. We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Senior Multi-Asset Execution Trader - Execution Services
description: About AFS Group At AFS Group, we connect markets, people, and opportunities with expertise, integrity, and innovation. As an independent, employee-owned financial and environmental intermediary with a heritage spanning more than 175 years, we empower over 3,000 clients worldwide through tailored solutions across financial markets, renewable energy, and platform services. Driven by collaboration, deep market knowledge, entrepreneurial spirit, and an unwavering commitment to ethical business, we help our clients navigate a never-changing world with confidence, creating sustainable value and lasting partnerships every step of the way. About Execution Services AFS Execution Services is an independent, agency-only multi-asset execution desk. We execute institutional client orders in equities, ETFs, fixed income, FX and listed derivatives and provide access to the major international equity and option exchanges. We work on an agency basis and never take the other side of a client’s trade. You will be based on the historic trading floor at Beursplein 5 in Amsterdam, combining electronic execution with direct market access and third-party brokers to get the best result. The role We are looking for an experienced Multi-Asset Execution Trader who has built a strong track record in institutional trading, ideally at a major international bank or brokerage. You bring deep market knowledge, an established network and a hands-on approach. You prefer to stay close to the market and the clients rather than move into a pure management role. Key responsibilities Execute institutional client orders across equities, ETFs, fixed income, FX and listed derivatives. Decide on the best execution route and get the order done. Use your market knowledge and network to strengthen client and counterparty relationships. Contribute to the commercial development of the desk. Travel to clients across Europe. Who you are Extensive experience in institutional trading, preferably at a tier-one bank or brokerage. Strong practical understanding of multiple asset classes and execution platforms. Established network within the institutional trading community. Hands-on, pragmatic and commercially minded. Strong communication skills and fluent in English. Affinity with financial markets, trading systems and Bloomberg. What we offer A unique workplace on the historic Stock Exchange floor in the city center Working in an awesome, internationally diverse (35+ nationalities), continuously growing, and highly driven team An organization where there is room for your refreshing ideas and to be entrepreneurial Focus on your personal and professional growth with support through training, coaching and development sessions Semi-annual evaluations including performance-based bonus scheme The opportunity to broaden your network and peak your sales by attending (inter)national events and congresses 27 paid days off per year Depending on where you live, an NS train travel card or bike lease options Free in-house gym Sponsored in-house lunch facilities Regular fun team and company events & the AFS Friday afternoon drinks Are you ready for a new challenge and do you want to become a member of this motivated and international team on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange? Please send your résumé through the application link. For questions, contact Teije Veenstra at Interview Process 1st get-to-know with the Corporate Recruiter online. 2nd Interview with Team Directors and an assessment at the office. 3rd Interview with potential colleagues. title: Architecture Internship | March 2027
description: Kickstart your career MVRDV is a globally recognised architecture and urbanism practice, headquartered in Rotterdam, with offices in Shanghai, Paris, Berlin and New York. Founded in 1993 by Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs, and Nathalie de Vries, MVRDV is dedicated to designing innovative, socially responsible, and sustainable architecture that shapes the future. As an intern at MVRDV, you’ll join an energetic, international team of over 200 professionals from more than 40 nationalities. You’ll gain hands-on experience working on ground-breaking projects, collaborate with industry-leading architects, and push the boundaries of design. If you’re passionate about architecture and eager to learn in a dynamic, creative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please note: We kindly request that recruitment agencies do not submit unsolicited candidates or profiles for this vacancy. We are managing the recruitment process internally and will not accept any agency terms or fees related to unsolicited referrals. Application Process You have between now and November 16th, 2026 to submit your application. Interviews will take place between November 23rd and December 11th, 2026. Successful candidates start on 1 March 2027! Important: You must remain enrolled in an eligible university study program between the 1 March 2027 and 31 August 2027 to be considered for an internship. About the Design Collective The Design Collective at MVRDV is responsible for designing innovative and sustainable buildings and structures. We work on a wide range of projects, from small-scale residential buildings to large-scale commercial and cultural complexes. Have a look here for some examples. title: Staff Engineer (m|w|d) - CRM Tech
description: Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer, you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences. This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership . You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains. You'll work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Braze, Snowflake and AWS services including Glue, Lambda and S3 in a modern cloud-native architecture . From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. When new CRM capabilities go live, you'll see the direct impact of your work in millions of customer interactions. The position is available in full or part-time. Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence. Lead technical initiatives within and across the team to align technical solutions with business needs. Drive continuous improvements across software development, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, and monitoring while evaluating new technologies where they add measurable value. Mentor engineers through technical guidance, architecture discussions and code reviews, fostering a collaborative engineering culture focused on sustainable technical excellence. Skills & Requirements You bring extensive experience building cloud-native software systems on AWS and designing distributed, event-driven architectures using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Kafka and modern backend technologies. You have deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, ETL processes and data integration, combined with hands-on experience working with technologies such as Glue, S3 and MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. You are experienced with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes, and are familiar with serverless architectures, AWS Lambda and modern CI/CD practices. You have a strong understanding of software quality, security and reliability, including authentication, encryption, automated testing and secure software development practices. You have a proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions and aligning engineering work across teams without formal people management responsibility. description: Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing? title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: Word jij onze nieuwe QA Specialist in Klazienaveen? Ben jij een kwaliteitsprofessional die energie krijgt van verbeteren, adviseren en het borgen van kwaliteit? Wil je werken in een organisatie waar je echt impact kunt maken en waar jouw expertise bijdraagt aan veilige en hoogwaardige producten? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als QA Specialist ben jij een belangrijke schakel binnen ons Quality Team. Je draagt actief bij aan het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van onze kwaliteitssystemen en ondersteunt de organisatie bij het voldoen aan GMP-, FSSC 22000- en ISO-eisen. Met jouw kritische blik, analytisch vermogen en verbetergerichte mindset help je onze processen elke dag een stap beter te maken. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's, met name van QC om kwaliteit, compliance en continue verbetering binnen de organisatie te waarborgen. Wat ga je doen? Adviseren van de organisatie op basis van data- en procesanalyses om kwaliteitsprestaties continu te verbeteren. Onderhouden en optimaliseren van het kwaliteitsmanagementsysteem. Coördineren en opstellen van de jaarlijkse management review. Initiëren, begeleiden en opvolgen van interne en externe audits. Beheren van afwijkingen, klachten, CAPA's en verbeteracties. Beoordelen en beheren van wijzigingen en uitvoeren van risicoanalyses. Uitvoeren van trendanalyses en vertalen van bevindingen naar verbetermaatregelen. Signaleren van kwaliteitsrisico's en proactief initiëren van verbeteringen. Nauw samenwerken met QC bij het beoordelen van analyseresultaten, afwijkingen, kwaliteitsrisico's en verbeterinitiatieven. Fungeren als sparringpartner voor QC en Operations op het gebied van kwaliteitsvraagstukken, compliance en continue verbetering. Ondersteunen bij leverancierskwalificaties en het monitoren van leveranciersprestaties. Ondersteunen bij validatie- en verificatieactiviteiten van processen, systemen en methoden. Beheren van kwaliteitsdocumentatie in Manual Master. Ondersteunen van verbeterprojecten binnen de organisatie. Verzorgen van kwaliteitstrainingen en bijdragen aan het kwaliteitsbewustzijn binnen de organisatie. Vrijgeven van producten conform GMP-, FSSC 22000- en ISO 9001-eisen. Requirements Een relevante HBO-opleiding. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de (proces)industrie. Ervaring met kwaliteitsmanagementsystemen, audits, afwijkingenbeheer en CAPA's. Ervaring met Change Control, risicoanalyses en continue verbeterprogramma's. Ervaring met trendanalyses en het werken met kwaliteits-KPI's. Kennis en/of ervaring met GMP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 en FSSC 22000. Ervaring met een documentmanagementsysteem, bij voorkeur Manual Master. Ervaring met Power BI voor data-analyse en rapportages is een pré. Kennis van validatie- en kwalificatieprocessen is een pré. Ervaring met grondoorzaakanalyses (bijvoorbeeld 5 Why's of Fishbone) is een pré. Een zelfstandige werkhouding, eigenaarschap en een pragmatische instelling. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Een cultuur waarin samenwerken, leren en verbeteren centraal staan. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, opleidingen en on-the-job learning. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds. Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning. Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales. Bridge commercial and technical Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises. Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently. Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership. Build the team Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America. Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely. Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure. What Will Make You Successful Experience Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both. Technical craft Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on. Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are. Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required. Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run. Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly. Commercial instinct You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped. You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer. You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath. Nice to have Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR. Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy. Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America. Why This Role GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast. You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible. If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. title: Head of Data & Analytics (m/w/d)
description: Über Scento Scento ist Europas größte Website für Parfum-Abfüllungen. Das 2024 gegründete Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Paris an der Place Vendôme und ein zweites Büro in Berlin. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung. Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren. Deine Rolle Scento verkauft Parfumproben und Abfüllungen an Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten, und fast jede Entscheidung hängt an Zahlen: Wie viel Marketingbudget lohnt sich, welche Düfte gehen aus, welche Kohorten kommen wieder. Als Head of Data & Analytics baust du die Grundlage, auf der diese Entscheidungen fallen. Du verantwortest das Datenfundament von Warehouse und Pipelines bis zu Kennzahlen und Dashboards, entwickelst Modelle für Attribution, LTV und Marge und prognostizierst die Nachfrage gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf. Erfolg heißt: Jedes Team arbeitet selbstständig mit Zahlen, denen alle vertrauen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Scentos Daten: Warehouse, Pipelines, Metrikdefinitionen und Dashboards. Du baust Attributions-, Kohorten-, LTV- und Margenmodelle, die Marketingausgaben steuern. Du prognostizierst die Nachfrage nach Parfums und Decants gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Team verlässliche Zahlen selbst abrufen und verstehen kann. Du misst die echte Wirkung von Marketing mit Inkrementalitätstests und klaren Experimentdesigns. Du baust die Data-Funktion auf und führst sie mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Tempo. Dein Profil Mindestens 8 Jahre in Analytics oder Data Science, davon mindestens 3 Jahre Führung einer Data-Funktion im E-Commerce oder Consumer-Tech. Exzellentes SQL und Statistik; Erfahrung mit modernen Data Stacks und Produktanalytik. Erfahrung in der Marketingmessung (Inkrementalität, Attribution). Fließend Englisch. Was wir bieten Ein Gehalt am oberen Ende des Marktes plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus. Remote-freundlich innerhalb der EU, mit Büros in Paris (Place Vendôme) und Berlin. Ein persönliches Lernbudget von 2.500 € pro Jahr für Kurse, Konferenzen und Bücher. Ein großzügiges monatliches Parfum-Budget, um den gesamten Katalog zu entdecken. Die Ausstattung deiner Wahl und ein Homeoffice-Budget. 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr, zusätzlich zu den gesetzlichen Feiertagen. Echte Verantwortung und schnelle Entscheidungen in einem Unternehmen, das in Europa rasant wächst. Gehalt und Bewerbung Gehalt: 135.000 € bis 175.000 € brutto pro Jahr, Vollzeit, unbefristet, plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus. Standort: Berlin oder Paris, alternativ remote aus der gesamten EU. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Vinted continues to scale and expand its product offerings, acquiring the right talent remains core to our growth, and our Talent Acquisition team is a key driver behind it. Proactive sourcing, designing fair assessment processes, delivering a seamless candidate experience, consulting business stakeholders on hiring decisions, and constant refinement to ensure quality and efficiency is our bread and butter. </p> <p>As a Talent Acquisition Manager, you will join our TA Leadership Team to shape and execute a forward-looking talent acquisition strategy aligned with Vinted’s business ambitions. In this role, you will build and empower a high-performing TA team, cultivating a healthy, collaborative environment grounded in our Leadership Way and core values. Serving as a strategic partner to senior business leaders and the broader People function, you will translate market intelligence and TA analytics into actionable hiring plans, lead high-impact recruitment initiatives, and drive continuous operational excellence.</p> <p>If you are an experienced TA leader passionate about developing people, optimising hiring processes, and scaling impactful talent acquisition initiatives, we would love to meet you.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and develop a team of TA Specialists, ensuring excellent performance, fostering growth, continuous learning, and a collaborative environment.</li> <li>As part of the Talent Acquisition leadership team, co-create and drive the implementation of TA strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Partner with senior business leaders and hiring managers to co-create and implement effective functional TA strategy in line with business context. </li> <li>Oversee end-to-end recruitment execution, ensuring quality assessments, efficient processes, and high standards across candidate experience.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on market trends, salary benchmarking, candidate pipelines, and resource allocation.</li> <li>Track, analyze, and report on key TA metrics to continuously optimise recruitment performance, improve process efficiency and quality of hire.</li> <li>Own and contribute to cross-functional TA projects, such as interviewer training, employer branding, hiring framework improvements, and recruiter enablement tools.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated track record as a Talent Acquisition Manager or TA Team Lead, managing performance, development, and growth.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, candidate evaluation techniques, and competitive talent markets across Tech functions.</li> <li>Experience using recruitment analytics to evaluate efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and inform decisions for improvement.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify root causes, and implement pragmatic, effective solutions.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence, guide, and collaborate with senior business stakeholders, hiring managers, and People team colleagues. </li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€78.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€105.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
description: <div class="job__description body"> <p><strong>Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.</strong></p> <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>Engineering Manager (m/f/d)</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a meaningful part of our engineering organisation. You will be leading one or more product engineering teams alongside the DevOps and infrastructure engineers, who own the foundations everything else is built on – our cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, architecture and observability. Across these teams, you'll own their health, growth and delivery, and you'll be accountable both for the products they ship and for the reliability, security and scalability of the systems beneath them.<br><br>We're also at the start of a deliberate change in how we build, with a greater focus on AI enablement. We're early in this, and we want a manager who's excited to help lead it – rethinking how the team works, what good looks like, and where human judgement matters most when agents do more of the building. What sits underneath all of this is consistency: working in financial services means the bar for security, reliability and correctness is high, and the people who build well here are the ones who take that seriously without losing pace.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, support and grow your engineers across product and platform – running thoughtful 1-to-1s, setting clear expectations, and helping people develop toward the careers they want.</li> <li>Own delivery across your teams. Where you lead product teams, partner closely with Product and Design to shape a realistic roadmap and create the conditions to ship it well; where you lead platform and infrastructure, set the priorities that keep the whole organisation moving.</li> <li>Own the technical direction of our infrastructure and architecture – cloud, networking, data, deployment, and the patterns other teams build on.</li> <li>Hold a high bar for engineering quality, and balance new platform work against the infrastructure and architectural debt that any scaling company accumulates.</li> <li>Help lead our move toward agentic engineering — setting how the team uses AI coding tools well, building the workflows and guardrails for delegating work to agents, and keeping quality, security and review standards high as more of the implementation is automated.</li> <li>Hire well, and partner with other engineering managers and senior engineers to raise the standard of how the whole organisation builds, runs and secures software.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Next Moonfarian:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience managing software engineers — you've led at least one team, owned its delivery and growth, and you know how to develop people as well as systems. Experience leading more than one team, or a mix of product and platform engineers, is a strong plus.</li> <li>A strong engineering background in infrastructure, platform or backend systems, with the depth to set architectural direction and be respected by senior engineers.</li> <li>Deep, hands–on experience with cloud infrastructure — AWS in particular — and modern infrastructure practice: infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and observability.</li> <li>A coaching instinct: you take satisfaction in other people's growth and success, not only your own output.</li> <li>Clear communication, and the judgement to know when to dig into detail and when to step back and trust your team. You’re able to collaborate confidently with both technical and non–technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and evolving, and the role will too.</li> <li>Hands–on experience with modern AI coding tools – for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar agentic assistants. You use them in your own work, have a considered view on where they help and where they don't, and want to bring a team along with you as the way we build changes.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern web and cloud development. Our stack is built around TypeScript, Node.js and React on AWS – direct experience is welcome, but we care more about strong fundamentals and the ability to learn.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is unlikely to be a good match if you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Prefer to work in silos and focus only on one domain, as this role requires a highly collaborative approach and the versatility to recruit across all business functions.</li> <li>Are resistant to adopting an AI–first mindset and prefer manual processes over exploring automation and new technologies to drive efficiency and advance our engineering organisation.</li> <li>Are uncomfortable with calculated risk–taking and moving at speed, as we aim to innovate and push boundaries within the necessary constraints of a regulated FinTech environment.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus. </strong>Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.</li> <li><strong>We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence. </strong>We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.</li> <li><strong>We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together.</strong> We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.</li> <li><strong>We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. </strong>We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.</li> </ul> <p>We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone  — regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity — knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.</p> <p>*Minimum investments vary according to jurisdiction.</p> </div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft. You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation. Who will thrive in this role Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey. Who you are Scaled something from zero : a site, a market, a process or a program. Managed a physical operation : quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor. Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills : you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day. Built a mechanism that held : a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked. Own numbers rather than report them : you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards. Understand frontline work : one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ. You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not. Backgrounds that translate well Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement Strategy & Operations Transformation manager Launch and Expansion Manager Regional operations manager We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out. Hiring process Our hiring process is fast. Initial screen (15 min) Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: People Advisor
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the role You're the local face of People at Legora: bringing local expertise, judgement and a strong understanding of employment practices to support employees and managers through a range of people matters. You will provide local advisory support, run local casework from start to finish, fill process and policy gaps, and make sure the employee experience in your market is accurate, timely and well handled. This is a hands-on, operational role and a strong launchpad for your next step. You'll be close enough to the business to understand how each function really works, trusted to make real judgment calls on the ground, and sharp enough to know when something needs a specialist instead. Sitting within People Operations, you will act as an escalation for our People Operations Specialists, providing guidance and resolving matters that require local interpretation, judgement or a more tailored approach You'll partner closely with Employee Relations & Compliance, who own our jurisdictional frameworks, create consistent standards, and provide specialist expertise for complex, contested or legally sensitive matters. You'll also work alongside our People Business Partners, sharing local insights and supporting the effective delivery of people initiatives and organisational changes within your local market. What you'll own Provide practical advice to employees, managers and People Operations colleagues on local employment practices, policies and people matters that require interpretation or judgement. Running local cases from start to finish within the scope of your certification, including absence management, ongoing performance concerns and restructuring conversations, with each one properly scoped, documented and closed Handling intake for leave, accommodation and absence requests, resolving what's routine and recognizing what needs to go further Building out local process and policy, and ensuring people programs effectively land in your market. Identify opportunities to improve local processes, employee experiences and ways of working, collaborating with other People teams to implement improvements. Applying your market's jurisdiction playbook accurately and consistently, and flagging where it doesn't fit local reality Recognizing the moment a matter becomes formal, contested or legally sensitive, and handing it off the same day with everything the next person needs to pick it up seamlessly Keeping your certification and calibration current so your casework meets the same standard as every other market Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends, recurring issues and emerging risks to inform broader people decisions and improvements. What success looks like Employees and managers get fast, consistent, local support without having to wait on anyone Every case you run is well documented and would stand up to close scrutiny Handoffs are clean and immediate, and nothing formal or legally sensitive stays with you longer than it should Patterns you spot locally, such as a recurring issue or a risk building in one team, are raised early with both Employee Relations & Compliance and the relevant People Partner, before they become bigger problems You're a trusted, visible presence in your market: the person people choose to go to, not a channel they're told to use Who you are Experience in an HR, People Operations or HR generalist role, ideally with some exposure to employee relations casework A good understanding of local employment practices, employee relations and HR policies, with the ability to apply these in real-world situations. Able to stay neutral and steady under pressure, including with senior stakeholders Sound judgment on when to act and when to escalate; you'd rather flag early than guess Organized and detail-oriented, with documentation clear enough that someone else could pick it up cold Motivated by where this role can lead, with a genuine interest in growing Comfortable working within a defined playbook while bringing your own judgment to how it's applied Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Key Account Manager
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Key Account Manager (m/w/d) | Berlin Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen nach der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur Bauphase als zentrale Ansprechperson. Dabei sorgst du für eine transparente und verlässliche Kundenreise und beeinflusst maßgeblich die Kundenzufriedenheit. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur Bauphase. Du koordinierst Terminierungen, klärst Rückfragen und holst notwendige Unterlagen ein. Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei Förderthemen und gibst ihnen jederzeit Orientierung. Du verwandelst viele einzelne Schritte in ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis mit stetig hoher Zufriedenheit. Du baust aktiv eine neue Schlüsselabteilung mit auf und gestaltest deren Prozesse mit. Dein Profil Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und eigenverantwortlich. Du bist kommunikationsstark und hast einen ausgeprägten Customer-first-Ansatz. Du bist offen für Neues und hast Lust, eine Abteilung von Grund auf mit zu gestalten. Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Projektkoordination oder Key Account Management ist von Vorteil. Kenntnisse in Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpen, Elektrotechnik oder Großhandel sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Das bieten wir dir Eine attraktive Entwicklungsperspektive. Bei entsprechender Performance ist eine Vergütung über dem Marktniveau möglich. Ein hoher variabler Anteil ist an die Durchreifung deiner Kunden geknüpft und liegt damit maßgeblich in deiner Hand.
