title: Product Engineer / Builder
description: Why this role exists Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel. Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started. What you'll do Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD. What we mean by Builder Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better. We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.” How we build - The Tacto Engineer Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to. Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch. Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering . If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here. Who we're looking for Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft. You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter. You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus. You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise. You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack. You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how. You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building. Stack Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest. How we work We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. What We Offer The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have: Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. description: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS AJAT GmbH · Köln · Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Vor Ort !!!!! DEUTSCH MINDESTENS C1 !!! Endgeräte mit Microsoft Intune absichern: Du konfigurierst Sicherheits- und Compliance-Richtlinien, analysierst Fehler und führst Änderungen kontrolliert ein. Mit PowerShell automatisieren: Du entwickelst wartbare Skripte für Prüfungen, Konfigurationen und wiederkehrende Aufgaben – mit sicherer Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung und nachvollziehbarer Protokollierung. Sicherheitsbefunde bearbeiten: Du bewertest Fehlkonfigurationen und Auffälligkeiten, priorisierst Maßnahmen und überprüfst deren Wirksamkeit. Mit Kunden und Team zusammenarbeiten: Du erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, stimmst Änderungen ab und erstellst Dokumentationen, mit denen andere zuverlässig weiterarbeiten können. Eine abgeschlossene IT-Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration, sowie mindestens acht Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung . Zusätzlich bringst du mit: Sehr gute, praktisch nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in Azure und AWS. Du hast produktive Umgebungen selbst betreut und abgesichert und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag anhand konkreter Projekte erläutern. Fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune und PowerShell . Ein sicheres Verständnis von Identitäts- und Berechtigungsmanagement, Netzwerksicherheit, Protokollierung und dem Schutz sensibler Daten. Erfahrung darin, Sicherheitsänderungen zu planen, zu testen, einzuführen und bei Bedarf kontrolliert zurückzunehmen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau , da du technische Kundengespräche führst, Entscheidungen im Team abstimmst und Dokumentationen auf Deutsch erstellst. Die Möglichkeit, die Tätigkeit zum vereinbarten Arbeitsbeginn vor Ort in Köln auszuüben. Die Berechtigung, zum Arbeitsbeginn die ausgeschriebene Beschäftigung in Deutschland auszuüben. So arbeitest du Du übernimmst Verantwortung und sprichst Risiken oder offene Fragen frühzeitig an. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit, gibst Wissen weiter und nimmst fachliches Feedback konstruktiv auf. Auch unter Zeitdruck bleibst du strukturiert und stimmst dich zuverlässig mit anderen ab. Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, beispielsweise Terraform oder Bicep. Aktuelle Microsoft- oder AWS-Zertifizierungen als ergänzender Qualifikationsnachweis. Was dich bei AJAT erwartet Technische Verantwortung in Cloud- und Security-Projekten. Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team aus IT- und Security-Fachkräften. Direkter Austausch mit Kunden und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen mitzugestalten. Raum, wiederverwendbare Sicherheitsstandards, Automatisierungen und Dokumentationen aufzubauen. Deine Bewerbung Bewirb dich direkt über diese Anzeige mit deinem Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Überblick über zwei relevante Projekte – möglichst eines mit Azure und eines mit AWS. Beschreibe dabei jeweils deine eigene Aufgabe und die von dir umgesetzten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Nenne uns außerdem deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. title: Senior Technical Support Engineer II
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ping Identity: </strong></p> <p>At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. </p> <p>Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. </p> <p>While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. <a href="https://www.pingidentity.com/en/company/championing-every-identity.html">We champion every identity.</a> One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. </p> <p>We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. </p></div><p><strong>Role Purpose Statement: </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Technical Support Engineer II, you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless customer experiences by providing high-quality technical assistance. You will be part of the global support team, working on a shifted schedule that includes weekends to ensure continuous support coverage. In this role, you will assist with product-specific cases, manage case escalations, provide phone support and respond to alerts, helping Ping Identity deliver superior customer support.</p> <p><strong>Main Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Interacting with customers, responding in a professional and efficient manner, helping them identify and resolve technical issues.</li> <li>Meeting or exceeding customer expectations on response quality, timeliness and overall customer experience</li> <li>Acting as Queue Manager (QM) during weekend shifts, ensuring efficient case handling and triaging support requests</li> <li>Providing technical support across multiple products, ensuring efficient troubleshooting, identification of root cause and issue resolution</li> <li>Where assigned products are not within their core expertise, work within established product runbooks and escalate to the on-call Product SME as required</li> <li>Managing and responding to phone support and alerts, escalating cases as needed</li> <li>Communicating with customers and partners via the online support tool, and via audio and video calls and screen-sharing sessions</li> <li>Reproducing customer problems internally, to enable the development and testing of a resolution</li> <li>Collaborating with Support, Engineering, SREs, Product Management and Customer Success teams. Showing a respect for all team members and customers at all times</li> <li>Collecting information and documenting bugs with Engineering or Training/Documentation for product/service issues that are impacting customers</li> <li>Actively prioritizing tasks/workload with self-discipline and good timekeeping</li> <li>Adopting an 'always-learning' mentality, with a humble attitude about knowledge limitations, and the ability to learn from experience and informal/formal instruction</li> <li>Participation in escalation calls, when required, to brief stakeholder management on support cases, and assist in the creation of action plans aiming to solve customer issues as quickly as possible. Showing empathy for the customer's situation and listening with the intent to understand the situation clearly</li> <li>Ensuring best practices are followed and processes are adhered to, especially with regard to ISO27001/9001 compliance, security incidents and data breaches</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Typically requires a minimum of 5+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or equivalent work experience</li> <li>Excellent Communication - both verbal and written; support is conducted via web-based ticketing system, web conferencing and phone</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Demonstrable collaboration and teamwork skills</li> <li>Ability to prioritize workload and adapt to a fast-paced, follow-the-sun support model</li> <li>Ability to be a good listener; identifying key information in order to reproduce a customer’s problem remotely</li> <li>Strong background of working on Linux, Unix & Windows Enterprise Server OS, with mixed skills around administration and troubleshooting</li> <li>Solid understanding of the technical fundamentals of the Internet - you should have a solid knowledge of protocols such as HTTP, SSL and IPv4/v6</li> <li>Working knowledge of Java, web containers (e.g. Tomcat, JBoss) and web servers (e.g. Apache, IIS)</li> <li>Experience of virtualisation in an enterprise environment</li> <li>Cloud-based platform services - AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>DevOps deployments - Docker, Scripting, Kubernetes</li> <li>Networking infrastructure - Proxies, Load balancers, Firewalls</li> <li>Installing/tuning/code analysis of Java</li> <li>Java performance analysis - Heap maps/JMAP/GC</li> <li>Directory - LDAP, AD</li> <li>Databases – SQL</li> <li>Programming languages - JavaScript, Groovy</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Life at Ping:</strong></p> <p>We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. </p> <p><strong>Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.</li> <li>Regular company and team bonding events.</li> <li>Competitive benefits and perks.</li> <li>Global volunteering and community initiatives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Benefits: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule </li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Progressive Healthcare Options</li> <li>Retirement Programs</li> <li>Opportunity for Education Reimbursement </li> <li>Commuter Offset (Specific locations) </li> </ul> <p>Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.</p> <p><em>We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Model Validation Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰  £85,000 - £105,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits </a></p> <p><strong>⭐Our Model Oversight team</strong></p> <p>The second line of defence Model Oversight team (that’s us!) provides support to our colleagues in Borrowing, Fincrime & Fraud, Finance and Operations to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for a <strong>Model Validation Senior Manager - Gen AI</strong> to lead the teams’ oversight of Generative AI models/use cases (primarily built across Monzo’s Operations squads) to provide assurance that the models/use cases we use are not only good for Monzo but what's best for our customers.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Driving the embedding of the Model Risk Framework for Generative AI use cases across Monzo</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the collaboration with the first line of defence teams to strengthen policies, standards and procedures for Generative AI model, use case, system design and build, implementation, governance, monitoring and use.  Helping to embed best practice of Generative AI across the business. </li> <li>Own the setting and maintenance of Generative AI validation methods, evidence expectations and reusable technical assets with relevant 1LoD modelling teams, applicable across all model risk areas.</li> <li>Convert modelling/validation experience into controlled playbooks, tests and working examples that can be applied to 2LoD Validation standards and processes for all Generative AI models, use cases, systems overseen by the 2LoD Model Oversight team.</li> <li>Coach Generative AI validation methodologies, to 2LoD Model Oversight colleagues, whom already have transferable Machine Learning skills, to reduce reliance on any single specialist for the validation of Generative AI models, use cases, systems so it can be consistently applied across Financial, Credit and Fincrime/Fraud models. </li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Leading the 2LoD Oversight of Operational Model Risk</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform, and oversee, independent model validations of new Operational models (primarily Generative AI models, use cases, systems),  and changes to existing, using proportionate modelling techniques depending on the level of complexity applied. This includes writing clear and impactful model validation reports and presenting the findings in relevant committees.</li> <li>Build relationships with first line of defence modelling teams that develop Operational Models, and wider risk teams, to support the embedding of the model risk framework to help Monzo grow safely. </li> <li>Review ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure Operational models are performing within risk thresholds and providing support to the relevant model development team when further action is required</li> <li>Monitoring and measuring the overall level of Operational model risk that Monzo operates, and driving action plans with first line teams and appropriate governance forums to mitigate residual model risk within desired risk appetite.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Being a senior advocate of Model Risk Management best practices</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the effective operation of the Model Risk Oversight Committee as a regular attendee, contributing to the group discussion to improve model risk management.</li> <li>Promote and help embed a strong risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Monzo. title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.</p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p>We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systems</li> <li>Own the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impression</li> <li>Own development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rollout</li> <li>Build and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goals</li> <li>Use probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launch</li> <li>Work with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and review</li> <li>Explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgement</li> <li>Production experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on Java</li> <li>Comfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latency</li> <li>A solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systems</li> <li>Demonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described above</li> <li>Ad tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have it</li> <li>Comparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Assembly and Test Technician
description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE THE LAST FRONTIER ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed. Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule. Run test phases on assemblies and finished units and record the results accurately, so issues are found and fixed before hardware reaches the field. Help set up repeatable test processes, from test plans and rigs to how results are captured, working closely with our Senior Test Engineer. Write and maintain build instructions, test procedures and records, raising the standard of our engineering documentation as we scale. Spot and report problems found during build and test, giving engineers the detail they need to debug and improve the next design revision. REQUIREMENTS About You You’re a practical, hands-on technician who takes pride in building things properly and getting the details right. You’re methodical, you like a clear process, and you’d rather write something down than rely on memory. You might come from a technician role in engineering, manufacturing or a test lab, an engineering apprenticeship, the armed forces, or a mechanical or electrical engineering degree with plenty of hands-on build experience. * Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship * Essential An engineering qualification (such as an HNC/HND, apprenticeship or degree in mechanical or electrical engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience assembling mechanical or electrical hardware in a workshop, lab or production setting. Experience with basic soldering equipment Ability to work from engineering drawings, schematics and written build instructions. Experience running tests on hardware and recording the results accurately. Confident using common workshop tools and electrical test equipment, such as multimeters and bench power supplies. Comfortable owning your own tasks with guidance from the engineering team, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn’t go to plan. Desirable Experience writing or improving build instructions, test procedures or other technical documentation. Experience with electrical assembly such as wiring looms, crimping or soldering, or working with battery systems. Experience building hardware in small batches or repeat runs, rather than one-off prototypes. Experience with surface-mount PCB assembly Future Security Clearance Requirements As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance . While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it. To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years , hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks. Why ARD The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge. Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next. Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used. A small but growing team - You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across science, software and hardware, with no layers in between. As we grow, you'll help build the team and the ways of working that come next. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation Private Health Insurance from Day 1 Dental & Vision Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged ARD is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on merit, based on skills, experience and potential, and welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We know great candidates sometimes hold back unless they tick every box, so if this role excites you but your experience doesn’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you, especially if you bring a background or perspective that is under-represented in science and engineering. title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (f/m/d) - Dutch & German speaking
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies. Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions. Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience. Experience Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level. Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively. Change management using agile methodologies. Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. Other Requirements: Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs. Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages. Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports. Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions. Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration. description: Wer wir sind Die Klickrendite UG baut Marketing-Systeme, die aus Klicks Kunden machen: Websites, Tracking, Google Ads und Meta Ads. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI, vor allem mit Claude Code und ChatGPT Codex. Dadurch setzen wir in Stunden um, wofür andere Wochen brauchen. Was du machst Du arbeitest an Kundenprojekten mit: Websites, Landingpages, Tracking, Kampagnen. Du bist in den WhatsApp-Gruppen mit unseren Kunden und hältst Projekte am Laufen. Du nimmst an den regelmäßigen Marketing-Meetings mit unseren Kunden teil. Du baust und testest mit Claude Code und Codex, statt alles von Hand zu machen. Was du mitbringst Du studierst in Leipzig oder Umgebung. Du verstehst, wie Websites aufgebaut sind, und möchtest tiefgehend die Technik dahinter verstehen / oder verstehst es schon. Du kennst die Grundlagen von Tracking, Google Ads und Meta Ads oder willst sie schnell lernen. Du bist sehr gut erreichbar, per WhatsApp und Telefon. Schnelle Antworten & Umsetzung extrem wichtig. Du willst Ergebnisse sehen. Bei uns zählen Tempo und Output. Was du bekommst Du verstehst das System, wofür uns Kunden jährlich fünfstellige Beträge überweisen Du lernst direkt vom Geschäftsführer Oliver Mahrle. Er ist seit 2017 im Online-Marketing und hat unter anderem eine Finanzbildungsakademie von rund 10.000 € Monatsumsatz auf rund 5 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit aufgebaut. Spot opportunities and take them from 0 to 1 and beyond: analyze, test, iterate, scale Understand the problem first. Talk to customers, map markets and figure out what deskless businesses actually struggle with Get to product-market fit in new verticals. Find out which industries need Ordio most, validate quickly and build the go-to-market for them Drive geographical expansion. Evaluate new markets, size the opportunity and build the playbook for entering them Build AI-powered GTM engines. title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Germany (remote)</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>RVP Sales</p> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>native/C2 level German and English</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>A Quick Snapshot…..</strong> </p> <p>As an Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, spearheading efforts to uncover and nurture new business prospects while strengthening connections with our current clientele. Your role will involve deeply understanding client requirements, crafting personalized solutions, and ensuring top-notch customer satisfaction. Collaborating closely with Sales Engineering, Business/Sales Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners and clients, your primary focus will be on prospecting, managing and closing new business opportunities for enterprise-wide CONGA solutions with organizations across a variety of key strategic industries/verticals in the B2B space.  </p> <p><strong>Why it’s big deal… </strong> </p> <p>You'll have the chance to sell high-impact, mission-critical projects with substantial value, driving transformational change for our clients in Central Europe. Your role will involve skillfully crafting and implementing territory, account, and opportunity plans to optimize revenue within your assigned selling patch. You'll expertly manage sales opportunities throughout every stage of the cycle, ensuring success for both our clients and our company. </p> <p><strong>Are you the person we are looking for? </strong> </p> <p><strong>Proven track record.</strong> You have at least 5 years successful B2B technology Enterprise sales experience in the SaaS industry, in Central Europe. </p> <ul> <li>Proficiency in revenue management principles is crucial. </li> <li>You have a consistent track record of over achieving quota and revenue targets.  </li> <li>You cultivate and leverage strategic relationships with partners to drive mutual business growth and success. </li> <li>Knowledge and experience in general AI and machine learning can bring significant value. You understand how AI can enhance revenue management processes. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Hunter mentality. </strong>You'll have the opportunity to unleash your inner hunter and drive our growth through relentless pursuit of new business opportunities. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your strategic mindset and tenacity to identify, pursue, and close deals with potential clients. The focus is 90% new business. </p> <p><strong>Solution Selling. </strong>Collaborate with prospects and clients to understand their unique challenges and business goals. Present Conga's comprehensive suite of solutions and services that align with clients' needs, demonstrating a deep understanding of how Conga can provide value. <br><br><strong>Drive</strong>. You have the ability to successfully leverage resources and take initiative. The most successful Conga reps are the ones who stop at nothing to achieve success no matter the circumstance. </p> <p><strong>Communication</strong>: You have the ability to articulate complex technology concepts to a technical and non-technical audience. You also have superb listening skills and you understand objections and overcome them by turning skeptics into enthusiastic new customers and brand ambassadors. You possess Excellent written and verbal communication skills. </p> <p><strong>Growth Mindset</strong>. As the business landscape is constantly evolving you adapt to changes in market conditions, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics. You innovate and develop creative solutions to address challenges and capitalize on opportunities in the revenue management space. </p> <p><strong>Collaboration.</strong>  You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional value to our clients and drive mutual success. Together, we'll leverage each other's expertise and insights to achieve our goals and surpass expectations. You have the gravitas to lead a winning team, leveraging the strengths and skills of the organization to deliver profitable business to the organization. </p> <p><strong>What will give you an edge...</strong> </p> <p>Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with a good understanding of CPQ, revenue optimization, CLM, doc-gen and e-signature products. </p> <p>Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research considered a plus.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong> </p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong> </p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  </p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI</h1> <p>Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.</p> <p>We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.</p> <p>This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and shipping <strong>end-to-end AI agents</strong> that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more</li> <li><strong>Crossing organizational boundaries</strong> to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission</li> <li>Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity</li> <li>Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions</li> </ul> <h2>You Should Have</h2> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of software engineering experience</strong>; you've built with LLMs extensively — whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself</li> <li><strong>Strong product instincts</strong>: you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec</li> <li><strong>LLM fluency</strong>: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos</li> <li><strong>Full-stack capability</strong> in TypeScript and Next.js—you can own a feature end to end</li> <li><strong>An entrepreneurial drive</strong>: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication</strong>: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself</li> <li><strong>An audacious appetite for impact</strong>: you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)</li> <li>Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications</li> </ul> <h2>How We Work</h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together</li> <li>We have the latest hardware and software—including frontier AI models on day one</li> <li>We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best</li> <li><strong>Stack</strong>: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Is Special</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your work is visible</strong>: This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction</li> <li><strong>Real stakes</strong>: thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact</li> <li><strong>Full ownership</strong>: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours</li> <li><strong>You're early</strong>: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you: </strong></h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3>Your mission</h3> <p>As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.</p> <p>The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.</p> <p>You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.</li> <li><strong>Build dependable data foundations:</strong> Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen production ML:</strong> Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Advance marketplace models:</strong> Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Set direction and priorities:</strong> Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.</li> <li><strong>Shape the technology strategy:</strong> Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <p>You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.</p> <p>Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical depth in one discipline:</strong> Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and systems thinking:</strong> Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production ML understanding:</strong> Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.</li> <li><strong>Business and product judgement:</strong> Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Relevant cloud platform experience:</strong> We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.</li> <li><strong>Streaming and integration experience:</strong> Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication:</strong> Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.</li> <li>The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.</li> <li>Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.</li> <li>The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where you'll be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>hybrid</em> role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

familiarity with thinkcell is an added advantage</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Our Values</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:</span><span data-contrast="auto"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Forward Thinking</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: We embrace change and challenge the status quo.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Ownership</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Customer First</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: We prioritize delivering lasting value.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Unified Team</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Strive for Excellence</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>We believe in a human hiring process, every application is personally reviewed.</strong></span></span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why is thinkcell the right place for you?</span></strong> </p> <p>We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises.
