title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
description: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt. Das Team Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen. Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab. Deine Aufgaben Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt. Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand. Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan. Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir. Nach wem wir suchen Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein Deine ersten 90 Tage: Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt. Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert. Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen. Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt. Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte.. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Jede Messe bringt uns mit Unternehmen zusammen, deren Energiekosten wir senken und deren Verbrauch wir dekarbonisieren. Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Event-Marketing bei trawa ist im Aufbau. Du erbst keine fertigen Strukturen, sondern etablierst sie. Flexibles Arbeiten: Dich erwartet ein schönes Büro in Berlin mit einer lebendigen Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten sind möglich, 30 Urlaubstage unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Weiterbildungstage, ein jährliches L&D-Budget und Coaching-Sessions über Sparrks. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs)
description: (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) Our mission for you European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk - and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex - combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings - all while helping companies switch to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it. About trawa trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future. We're looking for a (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) to own an important part of our energy value chain. You'll report directly to our Energy Operations Manager with close collaboration with the COO and Trading Team. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again - and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the office typically five days per week. The Team You'll join our Energy Operations team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll work hand in hand with our Trading Team as well as with Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: build and grow the business areas you own. What you'll do As (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development, you combine a strong analytical mind with business building: Build our railway power business: A significant share of our customers comes from the railway power (Bahnstrom) segment. You take ownership of this segment from a trading and energy perspective - you understand its specific market setup, improve how we forecast, source, price and supply railway power, and make us the go-to partner for these customers. You dig into how we currently predict our railway customers' energy demand and find ways to make these forecasts more accurate. You also build partnerships with IT service providers from the railway industry and with infrastructure operators. Lead international railway expansion: You drive the expansion of our railway power offering into further European countries - you analyse market structures, regulation and commercial potential, and contribute your findings into a concrete go-to-market plan. Expand our long-term product offering: Our customers buy long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Future/Forwards products. You develop our offering so we can provide more and better-fitting products to our customers. Architect of the long-term trading process: You centralise and streamline the end-to-end process from pricing and offer creation to actual trade execution across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations - making it faster, more robust and scalable, and ultimately enabling a better product for our customers. Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets - so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers. Who we are looking for Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results - without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration). Business acumen & venture mindset: You think commercially, enjoy building new business areas from scratch and prioritise by impact. Interest in energy markets & trading: You are fascinated by how energy markets work - from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing - and want to dive deep into them. First exposure to these topics is a strong plus. Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions - you find answers, push topics forward and enjoy a steep learning curve. High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. Communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives. 90 Day Goals After 6 Weeks (Onboarding): You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders. You understand our railway power customers, their contracts, how we currently forecast their energy demand and how we source, price and supply their energy. You have mapped our current long-term trading process - from pricing and offer creation to trade execution - and identified the key pain points. Month 3 (Ramp-Up): You are the go-to person for trading and energy questions in the railway power segment, have implemented first improvements and developed a concept for improving our demand forecasts for railway customers. You have delivered a first assessment of potential expansion markets for railway power, including a recommendation on which country to tackle first, and have identified and approached first potential partners among railway IT service providers and infrastructure operators. You have designed a target process for our long-term trading, started its implementation and proposed first additions to our long-term product offering. What Will Help You Succeed Work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting. Experience in energy markets - especially in energy trading, origination or pricing - or in financial trading markets. Knowledge of the German energy market and/or the railway power (16.7 Hz traction power) market. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter. Why us? Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now. The Role: You build business areas at the intersection of trading, energy and venture development - with direct impact on our revenue, our product offering and our expansion across Europe. Responsibility & Support: You own real business areas from day one - backed by our Energy Operations Manager, the COO and an experienced Trading Team who help you ramp up quickly and grow into the role. Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level. Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression. Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events. At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply - you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Partner Development Manager
description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises and public sector organizations are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we're committed to transforming the enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for Germany and the DACH Region focused on the Public Sector & Enterprise Market, you'll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses and government entities across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You'll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, technology partners, and public sector organizations to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of businesses and government agencies. Your work will directly contribute to our success. You'll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation in both commercial and public sectors, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the AI ecosystem. If you're a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world's most dynamic markets including the public sector, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI. Key Responsibilities Partner Strategy & Execution Define and execute Cohere's partner go-to-market plan for the Enterprise & Public Sector Market, aligning with regional business objectives. Partner with the broader GTM team to identify and recruit high-impact partners across system integrators, distributors, resellers, ISVs, cloud providers, and public sector consultancy firms. Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem, including government agencies, municipalities, and public sector institutions, to ensure partnership success. Partner Onboarding & Enablement Lead partner onboarding, certification, and training programs to ensure partners are equipped to sell, deploy and manage Cohere's solutions effectively for both commercial and public sector customers. Collaborate with enablement to scale partner enablement through sales and technical workshops, empowering them to deliver value to enterprise customers and government agencies. Pipeline Generation & Co-Selling Own joint pipeline generation by creating co-sell motions, solution plays, and strategic joint go-to market motions that align Cohere's capabilities with enterprise mission needs and public sector procurement cycles. Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue high-value opportunities in both commercial and government contracts. Business Planning & Performance Tracking Ensure partners are aligned with Cohere's strategic goals and performance metrics, including public sector compliance and reporting requirements. Run joint business planning sessions and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with partners, tracking sourced and influenced ARR against targets. Partner Advocacy & Feedback Serve as the voice of the partner within Cohere, relaying feedback to Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Work with Cohere's Public Policy teams to navigate government AI policies and regulations to advise partners on risk management and responsible AI best practices for the public sector. Thought Leadership & Evangelism Evangelize Cohere's vision and solutions at partner and industry events, positioning Cohere as a leader in responsible GenAI for both commercial and public sector markets. Build thought leadership through briefings, speaking engagements, and collaborative initiatives focused on AI in government and public services. Why You'll Love This Role This is a high-impact role where you'll shape the future of AI partnerships in both commercial and public sectors. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business, and policy, driving growth while ensuring responsible AI adoption across enterprises and government organizations. title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team. Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers Who you are We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel. Typically, your profile will look like this: Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it What makes this exciting You own a lever the whole company feels. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What the process will look like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage: Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics Offer, contract signing and onboarding Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of People Operations (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. Über die Rolle Als Head of People Operations baust du das operative HR-Fundament für unsere bald mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden im Berliner HQ und unseren deutschlandweiten Portfoliounternehmen. Wir wachsen monatlich durch Zukäufe von Hausverwaltungen. Damit treffen unterschiedliche Verträge, Datenbestände und Arbeitsweisen aufeinander. Du sorgst dafür, dass daraus verlässliche Personalprozesse entstehen, die mit jeder weiteren Übernahme funktionieren. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Personio, korrekten Mitarbeiterdaten, standardisierten HR-Prozessen und der Bearbeitung konkreter Personal- und Arbeitsrechtsfälle . Du entwirfst die Abläufe, setzt sie selbst um und verantwortest, dass sie im Alltag funktionieren. Bei Kündigungen, Vertragsfragen und Konflikten bist du ein kompetenter Sparringspartner für unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte und bindest bei Bedarf Legal oder externe Rechtsberatung ein. Führungskräfteentwicklung, Performance Reviews sowie die Gestaltung von Salary Bands und Benefits liegen bei Operations und den verantwortlichen Führungskräften. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Du verantwortest Personio und unsere Mitarbeiterdaten. Personio läuft bereits deutschlandweit. Du entwickelst die Konfiguration, Berechtigungen und Workflows weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Daten vollständig, aktuell und belastbar sind. Du integrierst neue Gesellschaften in unsere People Operations. Du prüfst vorhandene Daten und Prozesse, klärst Unstimmigkeiten und überführst neue Portfoliounternehmen in unsere Systeme und Standards. Du baust wiederholbare HR-Prozesse und setzt sie um. Von Vertragserstellung und Onboarding über Vertragsänderungen und Beförderungen bis zum Offboarding definierst du klare Zuständigkeiten, Freigaben und Kontrollen. Du begleitest konkrete arbeitsrechtliche Fälle. Du klärst Sachverhalte, berätst unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte zu möglichen nächsten Schritten und steuerst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Entscheidern und Rechtsberatern. Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Payroll-Daten. Du sorgst dafür, dass relevante Änderungen korrekt und rechtzeitig bei den Verantwortlichen für die Abrechnung ankommen, und klärst Abweichungen. Du verbesserst das System hinter dem Einzelfall. Wiederkehrende Probleme übersetzt du in bessere Vorlagen, klare Abläufe und passende Automatisierungen. Mit operativem Reporting machst du Datenlücken, offene Vorgänge und Integrationsfortschritte sichtbar. Du passt, wenn du bereits operative HR-Verantwortung für mehrere Hundert Mitarbeitende übernommen hast, idealerweise über mehrere Gesellschaften oder Standorte hinweg. HR-Prozesse selbst aufgebaut, eingeführt und anschließend im laufenden Betrieb verantwortet hast. title: Director, European Government Operations
description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space. WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe Professional fluency in German and English Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas . WHAT TO EXPECT We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. Important information: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here . Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY: For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org is building consumer software for people who love to fly: mobile apps, websites, and web apps for flyers, flight enthusiasts, and pilots. We haven't announced what we're building, and we're not going to spoil it in a job posting. What we can tell you: it's a consumer app with a large user base, and the design decisions made in the next year will define the next chapter of growth for the product.</p> <p>That's why we're hiring a UX Product Designer; specifically, someone who has shipped consumer apps that real people download, rate, and decide to keep or delete, and who can take a loosely defined problem and come back with something worth building.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-end product design for consumer aviation apps on iOS and Android, along with the websites and web apps that support them</li> <li>Design for a wide range of users, from casual flyers and aviation enthusiasts to working pilots who need information that's fast, accurate, and trustworthy</li> <li>Run product explorations: sketch out directions, pressure-test them with users and the team, and kill the weak ones early</li> <li>You'll get context and constraints from Design Leadership, PM and engineering, but the design leadership on your projects is yours</li> <li>Ship to the App Store and Google Play, then keep refining based on how people actually use what you shipped: analytics, experiments, reviews, and user research</li> <li>Raise the bar on craft across the org, through your own work and through feedback on everyone else's</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product design experience minimum. </li> <li>A track record of shipping features for consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, ideally at a startup, a big tech company, or both</li> <li>Products you've designed that are live and in users' hands. We will ask about them, in detail: what you decided, what you got wrong, what you'd change</li> <li>Deep fluency in native iOS and Android design (Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design) and strong systems thinking across mobile and web. You know when a pattern should be shared across platforms and when it shouldn't</li> <li>Experience using data to shape design decisions, from engagement and retention metrics to App Store feedback</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. If you need a fully scoped ticket before you can start, this won't be a fit</li> <li>A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just polished final screens</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're a pilot, student pilot, plane spotter, or all-around aviation nerd. You'd be designing for people like you, and that matters</li> <li>Experience designing consumer apps built around real-time data, maps, or location</li> <li>Experience growing a consumer app: onboarding, retention, subscriptions, or monetization, social posting and marketing collateral</li> <li>Experience working alongside AI/ML teams, or designing products with AI-driven features</li> <li>You've shipped consumer products in a domain with real-world constraints (regulated industries, safety-adjacent, hardware-adjacent) and know how that shapes design</li> </ul> <p><strong>About The Team:</strong></p> <p>AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the product development startup culture of a smaller team based in the UK – building for an audience that genuinely cares about flying.</p> <p>If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. title: Director of Sales
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! We are expanding our commercial team and seeking a highly driven Director of Sales to lead the sales team to drive global revenue growth. You will be responsible for leading the sales team’s success in achieving quarterly sales targets, collaborating with internal production stakeholders to meet customer product delivery commitments, and developing a high-performing sales organization. What you'll be doing Revenue Growth and Reporting Drive Revenue Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive sales plans to meet and exceed revenue targets across a global customer base. Sales Strategies: Work with the account managers, Product, and Business Development to drive sales growth across target regions and customers. Sales typically arise from new government-funded quantum compute platforms at research and academic institutions. Sales cycles can be lengthy (~12 months) and complex involving relationship building at the research labs as well as with ecosystem partners. Sales Reporting: Oversee sales forecasting and report on metrics-driven performance against bookings and revenue goals. Team Leadership Build and Mentor: Train, mentor and recruit as required a high-performing sales team (3-5 FTE) in alignment with the QuantWare go-to-market strategic objectives. FAE management: Establish FAE goals to ensure a positive customer experience with pre-sales and post-sales technical support Partner with Business Development: Work closely with Business Development (BD) leadership to ensure Sales and BD are coordinated across Strategic Accounts and Government tenders. Customer Relationship Management Voice of the Customer: Ensure the sales team plays a strong role internally at QW as the voice of the customer, relaying customer feedback regarding delivery and product performance, as well as communicating new developments in customer requirements, Contract Negotiation: Lead product pricing negotiations in coordination with the account management team and Product Management Your Profile Experience: 5+ years of sales experience in a technical or deep-tech industry. Leadership: 3+ years of experience building, leading, and scaling high-performing sales teams. Ecosystem Experience: Experience working with a diverse partner ecosystem, including Value-Added Resellers (VARs), systems integrators, distributors, and other strategic channel partners. Technical Acumen: Ability to engage credibly with customers, partners, and the quantum computing ecosystem, while collaborating effectively with Product and Engineering leadership. Education: Bachelor’s degree required. A degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is strongly preferred. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening. title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description: Keep our supply chain moving – ensuring 100% material availability for next-level radar systems. As our Senior Procurement Specialist, you keep our supply chain running smoothly and secure critical components for high-tech radars. You own key supplier relationships, resolve complex delivery bottlenecks, and mentor junior buyers across the team. Working closely with Production, Logistics, Service & Support, and Sales, you ensure parts arrive on time. You report to the Head of Procurement and keep our production line moving without a hitch. What you'll do Strategic sourcing and negotiation: Prepare proposals, request quotes, and negotiate competitive purchasing terms and pricing. Focus on high-complexity categories like PCBs, custom cabling, and computer components. Supplier relationship management: Manage daily vendor operations and build strong long-term relationships with critical suppliers. Conduct regular performance reviews and on-site visits to drive continuous improvement. Operational supply chain support: Ensure on-time sourcing of parts for Manufacturing and Service & Support teams. Resolve daily supply chain showstoppers and coordinate non-conformances quickly across departments. Data integrity and system accuracy: Maintain precise supplier and category data in our ERP system. Keep lead times, contact details, and BOM cost prices up to date at all times. Process improvement and escalation: Act as the primary escalation point for complex delivery disputes and bottlenecks. Identify process gaps and implement practical automation to boost purchasing efficiency. What you bring BA or MSc in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of procurement and strategic sourcing experience in technical manufacturing. Strong background in sourcing electronics, PCBs, cabling, and computing hardware. Deep expertise in ERP systems like SAP or NetSuite and MRP logic. Fluent English, both spoken and written. Strong analytical skills, financial acumen, and high attention to detail. Collaborative team player comfortable communicating across diverse cultures and technical teams. Willingness to travel occasionally to supplier sites. N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you. A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding. What we offer Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company; Comprehensive pension plan; Commuting allowance; 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days); Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications; High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role; An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from; As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world. We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH. Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Real-World Data Associate
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Purpose of the role As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co , our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself. Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster. Key responsibilities Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are We’re looking for Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift You can test APIs and check data with SQL Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest. Nice to have CircleCI or a similar CI tool Working with an external testing partner Payments, checkout or ticketing systems Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Matched pension, or 401k for US staff. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it. RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge. We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations. Our values Electronic music is art. We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music. We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community. We honour the past, present and future of electronic music. We use innovation to empower the community. We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit. We're always front left. title: InDomo | AI & Marketing Transformation Internship
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><h2>About InDomo</h2> <p>InDomo is a WPP company and the trusted transformation partner for multinationals ready to unlock rapid digital business growth. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with marketing leaders to build bespoke, in-house performance marketing capabilities that break down silos, put the consumer at the centre, and drive measurable commercial impact.</p> <p>In 2026, our focus has sharpened around AI-powered marketing transformation. We help brands navigate the shift to an AI-driven world by designing new ways of working, deploying intelligent marketing agents, and leveraging WPP Open (WPP’s proprietary AI platform) to deliver breakthrough results. We are scaling our AI practice rapidly and looking for a sharp, motivated intern to join the team and contribute from day one.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is not a coffee-and-PowerPoint internship. As our AI & Marketing Transformation Intern, you will be embedded in a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You’ll support real client engagements, help build AI-powered solutions, and contribute to shaping how some of the world’s biggest brands adopt AI in their marketing.</p> <p>You’ll be given real responsibility, direct access to senior team members, and the opportunity to develop skills that sit at the cutting edge of where marketing is heading. If you’re finishing a Master’s programme and want to hit the ground running in AI-driven marketing transformation, this is the role.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <h3>AI Agent Development Support</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the design, testing, and iteration of custom AI expert agents for enterprise marketing clients.</li> <li>Help build and refine AI-powered workflows using WPP Open and adjacent tooling, working alongside senior team members.</li> <li>Research and experiment with AI tools, techniques, and frameworks (such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and API integrations) to support solution development.</li> <li>Document agent performance, capture learnings, and contribute to our internal knowledge base.</li> </ul> <h3>Workshops & Client Engagement</h3> <ul> <li>Support the preparation and delivery of AI Discovery Workshops and transformation sessions for senior marketing leaders.</li> <li>Help develop workshop materials, including diagnostic frameworks, interactive exercises, and output templates.</li> <li>Attend and contribute to client meetings, with the opportunity to present specific sections or findings as your confidence grows.</li> <li>Support the delivery of internal training and enablement sessions on AI tools and ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Go-to-Market & Research</h3> <ul> <li>Help develop pitch decks, case studies, proposals, and other sales collateral for new business development.</li> <li>Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep our AI propositions sharp and well-positioned.</li> <li>Contribute to the packaging and refinement of InDomo’s AI service offerings.</li> </ul> <h3>Platform & Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Become proficient in WPP Open, exploring new features and capabilities and sharing findings with the team.</li> <li>Stay on top of the rapidly evolving AI and marketing technology landscape, surfacing relevant tools, trends, and opportunities.</li> <li>Bring fresh thinking. We value your perspective as someone close to the latest academic research and emerging ideas.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <h3>Must-Haves</h3> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Strategy, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline.</li> <li>A genuine, demonstrable interest in AI and its application to marketing or business. You’ve explored AI tools beyond the basics and can talk about what you’ve learned.</li> <li>Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills. You can take a complex topic, break it down, and communicate it clearly.</li> <li>Confident communicator who is comfortable presenting ideas to a room, whether that’s a team meeting or a client session.</li> <li>Excellent written and visual communication. You can structure a compelling deck or write a clear, persuasive brief.</li> <li>Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, work independently when needed, and don’t wait to be told what to do.</li> <li>Available for a full-time, 6-month internship based in Amsterdam.</li> </ul> <h3>Strong Pluses</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with AI tools in an academic or personal project context, such as building chatbots, experimenting with LLMs, using AI coding assistants, or working with APIs.</li> <li>Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agent architectures.</li> <li>Previous internship or work experience in marketing, consulting, or a technology-related field.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise platforms (e.g., CRM systems, marketing automation tools, or analytics platforms).</li> <li>Familiarity with Dutch and/or international market dynamics.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Offer</h2> <p>As part of the WPP network, you’ll have access to a world-class professional environment and a comprehensive set of benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Real, meaningful work on live client engagements with some of the world’s biggest brands. No busywork.</li> <li>Direct mentorship from experienced AI and marketing transformation leaders.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with WPP Open and cutting-edge AI tooling that most people only read about.</li> <li>A competitive internship compensation.</li> <li>Access to WPP’s global learning resources and professional development programmes.</li> <li>Light, open-plan office space with roof terrace, on-site bar, and stunning views over central Amsterdam.</li> <li>This role is based at WPP Amsteldok Amsterdam and requires 3–4 days of on-site work, with the flexibility to work remotely 1–2 days a week.</li> <li>A strong foundation for a career in one of the fastest-growing areas in marketing. High-performing interns may be considered for permanent roles.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

similar experience.</li> </ul> <p>  <br>  <br><strong>Desired competencies / special roles requirements</strong><br>  </p> <ul> <li>Experience in Electrical Testing & Commissioning</li> <li>CompEx title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,  a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure: </strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.</li> <li>Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.</li> <li>Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will thrive in this role if you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.</li> <li>Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.</li> <li>Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.</li> <li>Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.</li> <li>Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.</li> <li>Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Java or Python.</li> <li>Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.</li> <li>Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>These would be a plus, but are not blockers</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with industry-specific solutions (fintech, telco, retail, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with AI/LLM platforms, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools.<br>Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles.</li> <li>Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Web UX/UI Designer
description: <p>Do you care deeply about visual hierarchy, interaction details, and how a webpage feels to use? Do you believe design isn’t decoration, it’s how products communicate, guide, and solve complex problems? If you enjoy refining pixels, building coherent web systems, and eliminating friction for smart users, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Our web presence is often the first interaction developers and teams have with JetBrains. As software evolves, our web products and tools need to clearly communicate complex concepts while staying intuitive, accessible, and fast.</p> <p>You’ll take ownership of major web design initiatives across our ecosystem. Instead of applying surface polish, you’ll tackle core visual and structural challenges, building scalable design patterns, improving user journeys, and shaping how our web interfaces operate across devices. You’ll collaborate directly with product managers and developers, bringing visual clarity to complicated workflows and ensuring our web pages meet the high standards our users expect.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Design responsive, accessible web pages and interaction flows.</li> <li>Build, maintain, and evolve scalable web design systems and UI component libraries.</li> <li>Turn complex technical concepts and user requirements into intuitive visual experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with developers to ensure implementation stays true to design intent.</li> <li>Test, iterate, and refine designs based on user feedback and real-world usage patterns.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Attention to structure, layout systems, and interaction details.</li> <li>A systems-thinking mindset that prioritizes consistency and scalability over isolated fixes.</li> <li>Clear, articulate reasoning behind design decisions when collaborating with other teams.</li> <li>Strong self-direction and comfort taking ownership of end-to-end design initiatives.</li> <li>Genuine curiosity about how users interact with web pages.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A portfolio demonstrating complex Web/UI/UX projects delivered from concept to production.</li> <li>Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools like Figma.</li> <li>A strong understanding of modern web standards and responsive design.</li> <li>Experience creating and managing web design systems and UI component libraries.</li> <li>A track record of designing accessible, inclusive web interfaces aligned with WCAG standards.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>Success means delivering web experiences that feel effortless, consistent, and visually refined. You’ll know you’re succeeding when complex user flows become clear, design components scale seamlessly across products, and both internal teams and end-users trust the quality of your work.</p> <h2><strong>Why join JetBrains? </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p>If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio and tell us about work you’re proud of.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-DNI </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere.
