title: IT Program Manager (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year. You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices. Your responsibilities Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework About you Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar). German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). title: Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d)
description: Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Als Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) verantwortest du die operative Steuerung unserer PV-Projekte von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur fertigen Installation auf dem Dach. Du bringst unsere Kund:innen strukturiert, effizient und profitabel durch die gesamte Projektphase und koordinierst dabei eng mit unseren Lieferanten und Installationsbetrieben. Du arbeitest KPI-getrieben, greifst proaktiv ein und lässt kein Projekt liegen. Deine Aufgaben Du steuerst PV-Projekte aktiv von Unterschrift bis Abschluss mit dem Ziel, die Cycle Time konsequent zu reduzieren. Du koordinierst den direkten, operativen Draht zu PV-Modul-Herstellern, Großhändlern und Installationsbetrieben und sorgst für reibungslose Abstimmung bei Beschaffung, Terminierung und Durchführung. Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen. Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht. Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt. Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten. Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf. Du baust die Prozesse für PV-Projekte aktiv mit auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, da es sie bei uns in dieser Form noch nicht gibt. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Technik, Handwerk, Energie, Wirtschaft) oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Projekt- oder Operationsumfeld. Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in Operations oder in einem technischen Umfeld (z. B. title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. At the centre of this problem space is an app supporting bus drivers, train attendants and station staff in their daily operations around the world. We're currently building the next generation of this app, making this an exciting moment to join and shape its long-term direction. Your focus will be on strategy, discovery, and outcomes, while the engineering team owns delivery and ceremonies. If you're excited about working on a constantly evolving product used by thousands of operational staff around the world, send us your application! About the Role Own the product lifecycle end-to-end: from identifying opportunities and running discovery , through shaping solutions and defining requirements , to measuring outcomes and closing the loop Co- own your problem space with business counterparts , building a joint partnership that replaces handover-based collaboration with shared accountability for outcomes Define product strategy and priorities for the app , working across teams and problem spaces rather than being bounded by a single team's scope Drive hypothesis-driven discovery and outcome measurement , defining success metrics before solution work begins and using them to make explicit continue , pivot , or stop decisions Partner closely with engineering on priorities , requirements , and release , trusting the EM and team to own delivery and ceremonies Collaborate with peer Product Owners to align on dependencies and deliver outcomes that span individual team boundaries About You 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a track record of owning products end-to-end: from problem discovery and business alignment to outcome measurement You think in outcomes and problem spaces; presenting a business case to a stakeholder feels as natural as running a discovery session with users Proven ability to build strong working relationships with business stakeholders and drive joint decision-making without relying on formal authority Experience owning product problems that cut across team boundaries, keeping multiple stakeholders aligned on direction and trade-offs You're energised by strategy, discovery, and outcomes; you understand that delivery coordination sits with the engineering team Strong analytical foundation; you can connect user research, usability signals, and business metrics to make confident product decisions Nice-to-have: Experience with mobile app products, ideally in an operational or logistics context We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey! title: Growth Marketer
description: About us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: Restaurant owners generally aren't on LinkedIn and they don't read e-books. They ask friends, search Google, and more and more often, they ask ChatGPT. We need someone who can find new ways to reach them and get those ideas live quickly. We're hiring a Growth Marketer to build and ship our organic and non-paid growth experiments. This role is for a builder, not a strategist. You'd rather ship a working test today than a polished deck next week. You'll take ideas from the backlog to live, measure them honestly, and double down on what works. Using AI and no-code tools, you'll build pages, tools and campaigns yourself instead of relying on agencies and six-figure budgets. You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets direction and priorities. You'll work in deep collaboration with our other growth marketers, product marketing and creative teammates, plus embed yourself in the wider org of Sales, Account Management, RevOps, Product, and more. What you'll be doing: Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't. Get Tebi recommended by AI: Own our visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews. Create and update content built to be cited, not just published, and track how often we show up compared with competitors. Build tools operators actually use: Build free tools, calculators and templates for restaurant owners, and scale our programmatic landing pages. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering. Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team. Turn word of mouth into a channel: Test referral and sharing ideas that turn merchant word of mouth into a steady flow of demo requests. Work with our Product Growth team to build the winners into the product. Keep paid and organic working together: Support our performance agency with landing pages, creative tests and tracking. Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo. How we'll measure success: Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market Demos from free tools, the reservation widget and programmatic pages What you’ll bring: Think like a growth marketer but move like a hacker. You know what drives results and how to build just enough to prove it Ship rather than spec. A working prototype today beats a polished plan next week Have built and launched things yourself, like pages, tools, automations or campaigns, and can tell us what happened, including what didn't work Already use AI to work faster and have a point of view on how it's changing the way people find products Are hands-on with no-code and AI tools (Framer or Webflow, Zapier or Make, Claude or ChatGPT, Cursor or similar), without being precious about the stack Are comfortable with data and honest about results, in GA4, HubSpot, Looker or whatever gets the answer Have creative, sharp ideas and the discipline to ship the unglamorous parts too Take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do. No task is above or beneath you Speak fluent English. Another European language is a plus Nice to have: Experience with SEO, and with AEO or getting a brand cited by AI tools Experience marketing to small businesses, or a background in hospitality Vibe-coding projects you're proud of We don't have a minimum number of years for this role. We care more about how you think and what you've built than how long you've been doing it. If this sounds like you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you. Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Events & Community Manager

title: Senior AI R&D Engineer - Performance - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring a Senior Performance Engineer to grow our pre-training efficiency team. If you are excited about making models fast and scaling them to thousands of GPUs, this is the role for you! Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. About the role: You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel. This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH. Your responsibilities: End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput. Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training. Hardware-Aware Modeling: Partner with AI Researchers to define model architectures for hardware efficiency without compromising convergence. Your Profile Basic Qualifications Are proficient in Python and the PyTorch library. Have a strong engineering background in parallel and/or distributed systems with proven track record of excellence. Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle). Deeply understand the CUDA programming model. Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI. Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight. Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team. Preferred Qualifications Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed). Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput. A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance. A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training. A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture. Compensation and Benefits Become part of an AI revolution! 30 days of paid vacation Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub Mental health support through nilo.health Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket Budget for additional technical equipment Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model JobRad® Bike Lease Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Named Account Executive,  (MN )
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for title: Director UX Design
description: <h1><strong>About HelloFresh</strong></h1> <p>HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.</p> <p>Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.</p> <h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p>This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.</p> <p>This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.</p> <p>The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.</p> <h1><strong>What You’ll Do: The Recipe</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Lead from the front. </strong>Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.</li> <li><strong>Turn ambiguity into clarity. </strong>Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.</li> <li><strong>Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. </strong>From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.</li> <li><strong>Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. </strong>Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.</li> <li><strong>Build design-technology capability. </strong>Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.</li> <li><strong>Make us AI-native. </strong>Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.</li> <li><strong>Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. </strong>Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Team leadership. </strong>A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.</li> <li><strong>High agency. </strong>You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.</li> <li><strong>A bias to ship. </strong>Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional craft and product taste. </strong>Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.</li> <li><strong>Design-technologist mindset. </strong>Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.</li> <li><strong>AI-native practice. </strong>You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.</li> <li><strong>Scale and systems thinking. </strong>Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h1> <ol> <li>Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.</li> <li>You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.</li> <li>Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.</li> <li>Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.</li> <li>Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.</li> <li>You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.</li> </ol> <h1><strong>What We Offer: The Toppings</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Scale and impact. </strong>Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.</li> <li><strong>A craft-and-AI-first culture. </strong>Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.</li> <li><strong>Real ownership. </strong>End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.</li> <li><strong>Growth. </strong>A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.</li> <li><strong>Global collaboration. </strong>Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. title: Senior Partnership Manager (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the <strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel.<br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>As our <strong>Senior Affiliate Manager DACH</strong>, you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships.</p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management:</strong> Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"):</strong> Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks.</li> <li><strong>Key Account Growth ("Farming"):</strong> Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion:</strong> Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products.</li> <li><strong>Operational & Tracking Excellence:</strong> Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds).</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control:</strong> Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels.</li> <li><strong>Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy:</strong> Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <h4><strong>Must-Haves</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region.</li> <li><strong>Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge:</strong> Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends.</li> <li><strong>Commercial & Analytical Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong Interpersonal & Negotiation Skills:</strong> Excellent communication skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude and a strong commitment to team collaboration and problem-solving.</li> <li><strong>Language Proficiency:</strong> Business fluency in both <strong>German</strong> and <strong>English</strong> (written and spoken) is required to manage partner relationships and engage effectively within our international team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>FinTech & Financial Product Interest:</strong> Prior experience or strong curiosity regarding personal finance, banking products, investments, or pension topics.</li> <li><strong>Tool Familiarity:</strong> Practical experience working with CRM and affiliate software platforms such as HubSpot, Impact, or similar enterprise partner management suites.</li> <li><strong>AI & Automation Curiosity:</strong> Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to streamline routine partner communication, market research, or operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.</li> <li>Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.</li> <li>A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.</li> <li>Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. </li> <li>Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month.</li> <li>Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.</li> <li>Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.</li> <li>You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><a href="https://www.raisin.com/corporate/raisin-applicant-privacy-policy/"><em>Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy</em></a></p> <p data-start="728" data-end="900">We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. title: Account Executive - Enterprise Grower (DACH Market)
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The DACH Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators — DeepL, Refurbed, N26 to Nestlé — helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.</p> <p>Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. We're a diverse, international team that values collaboration and curiosity, and we're looking for someone who's eager to share knowledge and keep learning.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive, Enterprise Grower at Stripe, you’ll manage the growth, retention, and expansion of enterprise customer relationships, while identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. You’ll own a named portfolio of high profile accounts serving as the primary executive point of contact for senior stakeholders across business, product, and technology. You will be responsible for defining and executing multi-year account strategies, generating your own targeted outbound opportunities, and orchestrating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles—from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation, onboarding of new products, activation, and expansion. You are an energetic and highly organized self-starter who understands how to navigate complex organizations, engage the right decision-makers and influencers, and succinctly communicate Stripe’s differentiated value—both business and technical—for each customer.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning new business with digital native and enterprise companies</li> <li>Build, prioritize, and manage a robust, multi-threaded enterprise sales pipeline, including multi-quarter forecasting and account planning.</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle end to end—from executive engagement and lead generation through scoping, solution design, commercial negotiation, closing, onboarding, activation, and early expansion.</li> <li>Proactively generate your own pipeline through targeted outreach (e.g. cold calling, blitzing, research, networking, events, partners) and by driving a clear territory and account strategy.</li> <li>Effectively manage and advance leads qualified by inbound and outbound sales development representatives, ensuring smooth hand-offs and high conversion into late-stage opportunities.</li> <li>Ensure every potential and existing Stripe user has an excellent, high-touch experience at every interaction, regardless of deal size, seniority, or stage of the relationship.</li> <li>Identify and deeply understand users’ business models, technical environments, and pain points in order to shape and propose impactful Stripe solutions and multi-year roadmaps.</li> <li>Orchestrate and coordinate cross-functional Stripe teams (e.g. Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations, Marketing, Partnerships, Leadership) to align on strategy and ensure internal resources are set up for user success and long-term growth.</li> </ul> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to enterprise customers, with a track record of top performance </li> <li>Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations</li> <li>A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally</li> <li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and in German</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the Sitting at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Sales, and E-commerce, you will translate product potential into measurable business results and uncover the product adjustments needed to scale the category. title: Werkstudent Creative Design (m/w/d)
description: Wer sind wir? Wir sind eine stark wachsende Google Ads Agentur mit Sitz in München. Unser dynamisches Team aus Digital Natives betreut die spannendsten E-Commerce Brands und macht sie zu den Marktführern im DACH-Markt. Um unser ambitioniertes Wachstumsziel im Bereich SEA zu erreichen, suchen wir dich als kreativen Kopf für unser Team. Deine Mission: Du entwirfst herausragende Creatives, die nicht nur ins Auge fallen, sondern auch unsere Kunden im E-Commerce auf Google Ads glänzen lassen. Als zentraler Teil unseres Creative-Teams unterstützt du unsere kreative Leitung und sorgst dafür, dass sowohl Kundenprojekte als auch interne To-dos schnell und in Top-Qualität umgesetzt werden. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für visuelles Storytelling hast und lernen willst, wie man Designs entwickelt, die wirklich konvertieren, dann bist du hier genau richtig! Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Als Werkstudent im Grafikdesign bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unseren visuellen Werbemitteln und trägst maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Kundenkampagnen bei. Deine täglichen Aufgaben umfassen: Creative-Erstellung für Google Ads: Du konzipierst und gestaltest wirkungsvolle Werbemittel (statische Grafiken & Videos), die auf Google Ads für hohe Klickraten und Conversions sorgen. Markenkonsistenz: Du erstellst CI-konforme Online-Werbemittel und sorgst für einen einheitlichen und professionellen Auftritt unserer Kunden über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg. KI-gestütztes Design: Du nutzt innovative KI-Tools, um den Designprozess zu beschleunigen, neue kreative Möglichkeiten zu erschließen und die Bildbearbeitung zu optimieren. Strategischer Input: Du entwickelst ein Verständnis für die wichtigsten KPIs, bringst proaktiv kreative Ideen für Kampagnen ein und hilfst dabei, Design-Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten zu treffen. Interne Grafik-Power: Du unterstützt das Team schnell und zuverlässig bei internen Design-Aufgaben, von Präsentationen über Social-Media-Grafiken bis hin zu Bannern. Deine Chance: Du arbeitest direkt mit Heike, unserer kreativen Leitung, zusammen, lernst von den Besten und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Welt des Performance-Marketings. Hier kannst du dein theoretisches Wissen praktisch anwenden, über dich hinauswachsen und den Grundstein für deine Karriere im digitalen Marketing legen. Qualifikation Kreativität & Leidenschaft: Deine Passion für Design ist ansteckend. Du denkst "out of the box", bringst frische Ideen mit und hast ein Growth Mindset – du siehst Probleme als Chancen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Erfahrung mit Videobearbeitungstools wie CapCut ist ein großes Plus. Neugier & Trendgespür: Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den Einsatz von KI im Kreativbereich und ein starkes Interesse an aktuellen Design- und Marketingtrends. Persönlichkeit: Du bist ein organisierter und ergebnisorientierter Teamplayer, der sich weiterentwickeln möchte und strukturiert an Aufgaben herangeht . Benefits Die Chance, unser außergewöhnliches Wachstum signifikant mitzugestalten Agenturgründer, die eine klare Vision für die Agentur haben und das Wachstum aller Mitarbeitenden proaktiv fördern Ein ambitioniertes Team, in dessen positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre du dich wohlfühlen wirst. title: Senior Software Engineer, R2 Metadata
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | <strong>Austin, TX | London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Metadata team owns the metadata layer that underpins every R2 operation, every object put, get, list, and delete flows through the systems we build and operate.</p> <p>R2 is growing rapidly, and the metadata layer must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.</li> <li>Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: System Engineer - Network Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil.</p> <p>You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows.</p> <p>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</p> <ul> <li> <p>BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience</p> </li> <li> <p>3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse  (or equivalent SQL language)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents)</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus Points:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000. </span></li> </ul> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div> <p> </p> <p> </p> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>
